jobs.description:

Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title: Senior Specialist, Electrical Engineer, Propulsion Control Systems***

***Job Code: 45697***

***Job Location: Canoga Park, CA or Hunstville, AL***

***Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off***

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and verification of propulsion control systems for advanced defense aerospace platforms. This role focuses on electrical and electronic hardware used in engine control, actuation, sensing, power distribution, and embedded control interfaces for mission-critical propulsion applications. The engineer will work across the full product lifecycle in a highly regulated environment where safety, reliability, and performance are essential.

**Essential Functions:**

* Design and develop electrical architecture, circuit designs, and interface definitions for propulsion control systems and subsystems.
* Support development of engine control electronics, sensor/actuator interfaces, power conditioning, wiring, and signal integrity solutions.
* Create and review schematics, requirements, interface control documents, test procedures, and design analyses.
* Perform component selection, derating, tolerance analysis, and failure analysis for aerospace and defense applications.
* Support hardware integration, troubleshooting, verification, validation, and qualification testing in lab and system environments.
* Collaborate with systems, software, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and test engineering teams to deliver integrated propulsion control solutions.
* Ensure designs comply with customer requirements, military standards, airworthiness expectations, and internal engineering processes.
* Participate in design reviews, root cause investigations, risk reduction activities, and corrective action efforts.
* Contribute technical input to program planning, cost/schedule estimates, and engineering trade studies.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership within assigned work scope.
* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.
* Travel: 25%.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior electrical engineering experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior electrical engineering experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior electrical engineering experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

  

* Experience with propulsion control components such as sensors, actuators, control electronics, motor drives, or power systems.
* Ability to interpret system requirements and translate them into electrical design solutions.
* 4+ years of experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, DMMs, signal generators, and data acquisition tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Experience with engine control systems, thrust vector control, electro-mechanical actuation, ignition systems, sensors or related propulsion subsystems.
* Knowledge of DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, IPC, or other aerospace/defense electrical standards.
* Experience with FPGA/embedded hardware interfaces, control system integration, or environmental qualification testing.
* Familiarity with requirements management and verification tools such as DOORS, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar engineering toolsets.
* Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related field.

*In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role California, is $106,500 - $197,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.*

jobs.description:
Job ID: 2617811

**Location:** Huntsville, AL, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-12

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Electrical Engr

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

SAIC has an opening for a Principal Electrical Engineer as part of a team providing hardware and software development solutions to the US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command Aviation & Missile Center at Redstone Arsenal in Huntsville, AL.

**Job Description:**

Use your analytical engineering skills to identify and manage electrical/electronic requirements and translate those requirements into system architecture, hardware and firmware designs for special purpose military weapon systems.

  

**Typical Duties:**

* Perform power budget analysis for fixed and mounted computing environment systems

* Perform circuit design, analysis, simulation and component selection for high availability, high reliability and low Size, Weight and Power (SWAP) environments

* Direct design verification testing (DVT) of prototype electronic designs

* Generate and review documentation for a Technical Data Package (TDP) associated with the design, development, unit test, and integration of hardware/firmware components

* Assess technical and integration risks and identify mitigations

* Review test plans and procedures

* Review and adjudicate Deficiency Reports

* Review relevant milestone contract deliverables and provide recommendations across the life cycle of a development effort

* Participate in internal peer reviews and formal customer design reviews

* Mentor junior engineers

**Qualifications**

**Education Requirements:**

* BS in Electrical / Computer Engineering plus a minimum of nine (9) years of experience; Additional six (6) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree (per contract vehicle).

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Must already have a DoD SECRET clearance or be able to obtain interim DoD SECRET clearance prior to first day of employment; US Citizenship required. Current SECRET clearance is preferred.

**Required Experience:**

* Knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

  + Embedded microcontroller hardware/firmware design and development
  + FPGA firmware design, development, verification
  + High speed digital design (e.g. LVDS, GigE, DDR3/DDR4)
  + Analog design for data acquisition systems
  + Switch mode power supply design
  + Motor control
  + EMC/EMI (MIL-STD-461)
  + High Altitude Electromagnetic Pulse (HEMP/EMP) survivability
  + Familiar with MLRS, THAAD and/or PATRIOT PAC-3

* Proficient using MS Office suite, MS Visio, schematic capture program such as Altium Designer, circuit simulation program such as PSpice. Excellent communication skills and mechanical aptitude.
* Experience with military radar systems, electronic countermeasures, weapon fire control systems, systems integration, and/or Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) highly desirable.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II – Precision Sensing & Seeker Systems
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
**Build a Career Protecting What Matters**
  
Are you a blossoming engineer with a passion for embedded systems and a drive to solve complex technical challenges? Join the **Market Expansion Software Team** at BAE Systems and help us protect those who protect us.
  
We are developing critical seeker, guidance, and control technologies for precision munitions within our Precision Strike & Sensing Solutions (PGSS) business. This is a unique opportunity for an early career engineer to get hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technology and make a tangible contribution to national security from day one.
  
**The Opportunity**
  
As a Software Engineer II, you won't just be writing code—you'll be learning the art of embedded systems engineering. You will be integrated into a high-visibility program, working alongside seasoned Principal Engineers and Subject Matter Experts. You will become a key contributor on a fast-paced program delivering demonstratable value at strategic test events.
  
**What You’ll Do**

* **Develop & Code:** Write high-quality, reliable code in C/C++ for complex embedded systems
* **Work with Cutting-Edge Hardware:** Gain experience with embedded processors, GPUs and military-grade sensors and electronics
* **Explore Operating Systems:** Work across a variety of environments, ranging from bare metal to Embedded Linux
* **Collaborate:** Partner with Systems, Hardware, and Test engineers to help translate requirements into efficient software solutions demonstrated on range
* **Learn & Grow:** Participate in design reviews and collaborate on engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* Strong foundational knowledge of **C/C++**, including an understanding of data structures, algorithms, and memory management
* Exposure to embedded systems development through coursework, internships, or personal projects
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with development boards (ex, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone Black, Arduino Uno, STM32)
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Coursework in signal processing, guidance, or control systems
* Practiced in the training and use of AI models beyond LLMs
* Exposure to Agile workflows, CI/CD tools, or static code analysis
* Experience with Python
* Confident and responsible use of generative AI tools used in the development of software
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $72150 - $122655
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  
  
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Location Huntsville, Alabama Category Engineering, Technology, & Science Job Type Full time Job Id R2129722 Posted Date 09/10/2026

  

**Title:**

Lead Systems Engineer

**Program Summary**

KBR’s Missile, Aviation, and Ground Systems (MAGS) division delivers mission engineering solutions for critical U.S. Army programs, specializing in aviation and ground systems, integrated air and missile defense, and threat and target systems. As a trusted partner of the U.S. Department of War, MAGS provides innovative, technology-driven solutions to enhance national security. With a global presence and a strong ethical framework, KBR ensures secure, effective, and mission-ready capabilities worldwide.

**Job Summary**

KBR is seeking a highly accomplished Lead Systems Engineer to provide strategic technical leadership in support of the Fires Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE)-Fires mission. The Lead Systems Engineer will lead multidisciplinary engineering teams responsible for integrating weapons, sensors, launchers, command and control systems, and networks into cohesive, interoperable capabilities that are joint- and coalition-ready. The successful candidate will work closely with government leadership, industry partners, and technical staff to develop and deliver affordable, rapid, and effective solutions that address critical warfighter capability gaps. This position requires expertise spanning systems engineering, acquisition, mission engineering, systems integration, modeling and simulation, test and evaluation, and capability fielding.

The Lead Systems Engineer serves as a trusted advisor to senior government and military leaders, ensuring technical rigor, innovation, and engineering excellence throughout the lifecycle of Integrated Fires programs. The individual will be responsible for strategic technical planning, system architecture and design, hardware/software/network integration, verification and validation, risk management, and transition of capabilities to operational forces. The ideal candidate will be flexible, self-directed, team-oriented, and capable of managing ambiguity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with the PAE-Fires Executive Leadership Team to define and lead strategic engineering initiatives that advance engineering tools, methodologies and digital engineering capabilities needed to accelerate delivery of warfighting capabilities.
* Serve as a senior technical advisor to Government leadership on systems engineering, mission engineering, technology integration, and capability development strategies.
* Develop and maintain long-range systems integration strategies, technology roadmaps, and engineering modernization initiatives.
* Oversee system requirements, architecture evaluations, technology trade studies, and performance assessments to guide development paths.

* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, technical trends, and innovative solutions applicable to current and future Integrated Fires challenges.
* Support and lead Analysis of Alternatives (AoAs), Courses of Action (CoAs), trade studies, engineering assessments, and performance analyses.
* Conduct objective assessments of system performance, operational effectiveness, and mission outcomes through scenario development, modeling, simulation, and engineering analysis.
* Lead systems engineering activities including requirements analysis, functional decomposition, architecture development, interface definition, requirements allocation, integration planning, and technical management.
* Guide the development and implementation of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) solutions and ensure alignment with Government Reference Architectures and digital engineering strategies.
* Assist the Government in translating mission objectives, operational needs, and customer requirements into system and capability requirements.
* Effectively communicate technical findings, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to senior Government and military decision-makers.
* Provide engineering leadership and oversight throughout the system lifecycle, from requirements development through fielding and transition to operations.
* Ensure the integrity, quality, completeness, and technical excellence of engineering products, analyses, recommendations, and deliverables.
* Resolve complex technical issues, risks, and conflicts affecting program execution.

**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Brief Summary**:

Senior Electrical Systems Engineers work closely with optical, mechanical, software, and test engineers to develop, verify, and validate requirements for cutting-edge complex optical and electro-optical systems. In the early phases of a project or program, they work to understand the customer's needs, internal capabilities, and participate in technology readiness reviews to identify capability gaps and developmental risks. They specifically lead the analysis in relation to electrical and electronics subsystems including integration of analyses from other disciplines. Senior Electrical Systems Engineers are responsible for understanding all system interfaces and leading the development of rigorous electrical integration and test plans to ensure each system and subsystem requirement is appropriately addressed. Subsequently, they execute on those plans by utilizing their extensive hands-on assembly, integration, and testing (AI&T) skillsets for electrical components and overseeing other disciplines’ AI&T efforts.

A Senior Electrical Systems Engineer leads a wide variety of technical activities during the product realization process for systems involving a high level of complexity, with an emphasis on electro-optic assemblies. Additionally, a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer will be expected to design, build and test custom electronics for testing and/or manufacturing equipment. With an electro-optical systems focus, they are primarily tasked with hands-on integration and testing of electronic components, PCBs, and interconnects. They are charged with leading the planning and execution of activities for projects that may involve precision cleanroom assembly, specialized equipment/fixturing, and custom test bed development. They help in assessing existing Edmund Optics equipment and processes to ensure requirements for a variety of products can be effectively verified. Additionally, a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer plays an important role in training and mentoring more junior engineers.

Responsibilities:

**Primary Responsibilities:**

Electrical:

* Review customer provided and supplier provided electrical and electronic designs, schematics, PCB layouts, and support documentation for suitability against system requirements.
* Evaluate electrical and electronic designs for functionality, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and testability; identify risks and recommend improvements.
* Develop or oversee PCB layouts, fabrication, and assembly for custom electronic hardware.
* Design, build, and test custom electronics and interconnect subsystems and test software for development, integration, verification, and manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and modify basic microcontroller firmware, including Arduino-like applications, for sensor acquisition, device communication, and equipment control.
* Document and support electrical design review findings and coordinate resolution of technical issues with the responsible engineers.
* Develop training materials and procedures for the use and maintenance of custom electronics and test equipment.
* Improve electrical design review, requirements management, integration, and verification processes using lessons learned from project execution.

Systems:

* Translate customer needs and/or technical data package and intended operating conditions into measurable system and subsystem requirements.
* Lead cross-disciplinary development, allocation, and review of system requirements, with specific responsibility for electrical requirements.
* Reviewing, defining and documenting electrical interfaces and coordinating their compatibility with mechanical, optical, and software interfaces.
* Maintain traceability between customer needs, system requirements, subsystem requirements, and verification results.
* Lead electrical architecture development and contribute to system architecture decisions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines.
* Coordinate resolution of technical conflicts between disciplines to maintain overall system performance and compatibility.
* Assess assembly and testing capabilities and recommend equipment and tool acquisitions.
* Understand system interfaces and the impact of each subsystem on top-level system requirements.

AI&T:

* Develop electrical integration plans that define interface checks, integration sequence, prerequisites, and criteria for proceeding to the next project phase.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary integration activities, ensuring that subsystem dependencies and interface requirements are addressed.
* Perform hands-on electrical assembly, initial start-up, integration, and troubleshooting of components, PCBs, wiring, and interconnects.
* Define verification methods and acceptance criteria for electrical and system requirements in collaboration with the engineering team.

General:

* Prepare and review technical documentation, including requirements, interface definitions, design analyses, test plans, drawings and engineering reports.
* Mentor engineers and technicians in electrical troubleshooting, design review processes, systems thinking, and disciplined test practices.
* Facilitate the assembly and modification of test equipment to support short-term project-specific and long-term strategic needs.
* Work closely with cross functional engineers to develop and evaluate interfaces between electronics and existing hardware and software.
* Evaluate and ensure the safety, performance, and reliability of new product designs involving laser diodes, photodiodes, image sensors, and other electronics.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills & Abilities****:**

* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, circuit analysis, interconnect and cabling, and practical electrical design and construction principles.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, laboratory power supplies, function generators, and related electrical test equipment.

**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

**Job Mission**

As a Field Software Engineer I, you help bring ASM's semiconductor equipment to life by supporting the software that drives robotics, valve systems, temperature controllers, and other advanced hardware. You will work closely with global engineering experts and customer teams to troubleshoot issues, refine specifications, and ensure our tools deliver reliable performance in real-world manufacturing environments.

Your work connects our most advanced technologies with the customers who depend on them, enabling the next generation of semiconductor innovation.

**What You Will Be Working On**

* Support Software Design Engineers in developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving software for ASM semiconductor equipment.
* Triage mechanical, electrical, and software issues across complex tool environments.
* Lead customer escalation calls with field support engineers and customers.
* Collaborate with QA and Support teams to incorporate replicated bugs into regression testing.
* Work with customers to define feature specifications and contribute to bug fixes or small feature enhancements.
* Author, review, and update system specifications, software designs, test plans, and related documentation.
* Investigate internal and external inquiries, perform analyses, and propose solutions or alternatives.
* Participate in system design discussions and cross-functional engineering reviews.
* Represent customer needs and priorities to internal engineering teams.
* Support customer software upgrades and validate customer-specific use cases before deployment.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, plus 3 years of experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Software development experience in C++, C#, or Python.
* Ability to read code and work effectively in a debugger or IDE.

**What Sets You Apart**

Experience with any of the following:

* Machine control software, including semiconductor equipment.
* Windows and real-time operating systems.
* Multi-threaded or real-time applications.
* Graphical user interfaces.
* Device drivers or interrupt-driven software.
* Data communications, networking, or EtherCAT.
* Dynamic scheduling algorithms with deadlock avoidance.
* Programming tools such as debuggers, text editors, application builders, and configuration management tools.
* Ability to read and translate software functionality into new implementations.
* Ability to understand specifications, design documents, communication interfaces, and API descriptions.

**Apply today to be part of what’s next.**

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

jobs.title: Space Systems Engineering Integration & Test Engineer - TIDES FPGA (PIE)
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

Department of Defense TS/SCI security clearance is preferred at time of hire. Candidates must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance within a reasonable amount of time from date of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:**

As a Systems Engineering Integration & Test Engineer - TIDES FPGA, you will be a member of the Payload Integration and Evolution (PIE) team within SEIT’s organization. The PIE team develops and evolves the Payload Verification Platform (PVP), a hardware development environment made up of COTS and custom FPGA boards, development kits, and supporting infrastructure used to emulate spacecraft payload behavior for early integration, risk reduction, and test software development.

In this role, you will help define, architect, and lead FPGA-enabled capabilities for the PVP, from early requirements and microarchitecture through RTL implementation, simulation, timing closure, interface integration, and lab bring-up. Your work will mature reusable test infrastructure that bridges test equipment with units under test, enables real-time functions such as packet timestamping and precision command scheduling, and supports payload programs as they move from early development toward verification and flight readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead FPGA-supported development and integration activities for the Payload Verification Platform (PVP) as part of the Payload Integration and Evolution (PIE) team within SEIT’s TIDES organization
* Architect, design, integrate, and mature COTS and custom FPGA-based development platforms used to emulate spacecraft payload behavior for early integration, risk reduction, and test software development
* Define FPGA and hardware integration approaches that bridge test equipment, payload hardware, and software infrastructure
* Lead RTL development, simulation, interface integration, timing closure support, and lab bring-up for FPGA-enabled test capabilities
* Drive real-time test functions such as payload interface emulation, packet timestamping, precision command scheduling, and protocol translation
* Collaborate with systems, electrical, software, test, and program teams to derive platform requirements and resolve integration issues
* Lead structured debug efforts using lab instrumentation, waveform analysis, software tools, and root-cause investigation
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews, integration planning, technical roadmaps, and platform evolution
* Document architecture, interface definitions, bring-up procedures, release artifacts, and lessons learned

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
* Significant experience with FPGA design, RTL development, hardware integration, and lab bring-up
* Proficiency with SystemVerilog and/or VHDL, simulation, timing constraints, and FPGA vendor toolchains such as Vivado, Lattice Diamond/Radiant, or equivalent
* Experience integrating FPGA interfaces such as Ethernet, SPI, UART, JESD204B/C, high-speed serial links, or custom board-level protocols
* Strong understanding of digital design, clock-domain crossing, reset strategy, synchronous/asynchronous interfaces, and timing closure
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, protocol analyzers, and waveform capture tools
* Experience working across systems, hardware, software, and test teams to define requirements and drive integration closure
* Proficiency with scripting and automation using Python, Tcl, Linux shell, or similar tools
* Experience with Linux environments, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and controlled FPGA artifact release processes
* Familiarity with payload integration, hardware development environments, spacecraft electronics, or verification platforms is strongly preferred

**What Sets You Apart**

* You think at the platform level and understand how FPGA design decisions affect payload integration, test software, lab operations, and program execution
* You can move comfortably between architecture, RTL, simulation, timing, lab debug, and system integration
* You have a track record of taking complex hardware/software integration problems from ambiguity to root cause and closure
* You write clean, maintainable RTL, scripts, documentation, and interface definitions that other engineers can build on
* You are effective in the lab and can isolate whether an issue belongs to the FPGA, board, cable, instrument, software interface, or test configuration
* You mentor others, raise the technical standard of the team, and help shape reusable platform capabilities
* You communicate clearly across disciplines and can translate between systems needs, electrical constraints, FPGA implementation, and test objectives
* You identify opportunities to use automation and AI tools to improve engineering efficiency, debug workflows, and platform maturity

**Our Commitment to You:**

* An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
* Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
* Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
* Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups,

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Design Studies
jobs.description:
Phoenix, Arizona, United States | Full-time

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

jobs.description:
Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable.

Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.

Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed.

### **About the Role**

You will own embedded firmware across Rainmaker’s vehicle and its integration with our onboard and ground control software systems. Your scope includes flight-controller firmware, power distribution, sensor and payload controllers, and the interfaces connecting those systems to onboard Linux software. You will take work from architecture and board bring-up through testing, manufacturing, deployment, and support in the field. We’re looking for a high-agency engineer who identifies what needs to happen, turns incomplete requirements into a clear plan, and follows through until the hardware works reliably in real operating conditions. This is a hands-on technical ownership role with the autonomy to shape the firmware architecture and the responsibility to deliver it.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of all embedded firmware across the vehicle, including flight-controller firmware, power distribution, sensors, and seeding payloads.
* Set firmware priorities, identify reliability risks and technical gaps, and drive projects from an ambiguous problem to a validated release.
* Bring up new boards with electrical engineers: read schematics, validate interfaces, write drivers, and debug failures at the boundary between hardware and software.
* Develop dependable device communication and command handling over CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C, with clear contracts for telemetry, timing, and fault behavior.
* Integrate firmware with our vehicle software so commands, device state, and telemetry behave consistently from the microcontroller to the operator.
* Design and validate safe startup states, watchdogs, interlocks, and recovery behavior for resets, communication loss, sensor faults, and interrupted updates.
* Own firmware builds, versioning, flashing, over-the-air updates, and recovery workflows so deployed vehicles run known, traceable software.
* Build automated tests, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet.
* Partner with manufacturing and flight operations to make provisioning, calibration, diagnostics, and servicing repeatable and practical.
* Investigate bench and field failures using logs, telemetry, and lab instruments; resolve root causes and turn what you learn into better software and tests.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing embedded software or firmware for microcontroller-based systems, including board bring-up, hardware integration, and deployment into production or field use.
* Demonstrated ownership of an embedded subsystem from design through release and ongoing support, including making technical decisions independently, validating behavior on hardware, and resolving failures in real operating conditions.
* Strong systems programming skills in Rust and/or C/C++, with the ability and willingness to work across both Rust and C/C++ codebases.
* Practical experience with peripheral drivers and communication buses such as CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C.
* Comfort reading schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers to isolate problems across electrical and software boundaries.
* The ability to reason about system failures and implement robust state machines, fault detection, safe outputs, and recovery paths.
* Experience building maintainable firmware with version control, reproducible builds, automated testing, and disciplined release practices.
* Evidence of high agency: you surface problems without waiting to be assigned, make sound decisions with incomplete information, ask for help when it matters, and close the loop on results.
* Clear communication and the ability to work closely with hardware engineers and operators, explain tradeoffs, and document decisions so others can build and service what you ship.

### **What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other systems where software controls physical equipment in demanding conditions.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate, small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we opened our Detroit manufacturing hub and field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

**The Role and Your Impact:**  
We need a Robotics Software Engineer who writes fast, correct C++ that runs on real hardware. You’ll work on the Archimedes stack alongside our Lead Software Engineer, taking raw sensor data and turning it into tracking, control and autonomy that has to work in real time. Performance and accuracy matter more than anything. Your scope grows as fast as you do; our Lead went from Founding Robotics Engineer to Lead in 12 months.

**What You’ll Own:**

* Production C++ across the stack: sensor ingestion, tracking, control and autonomy
* Working directly with drivers and raw sensor data, not pre-packaged inputs
* Threading, process architecture and performance on the paths you own
* Timing and latency analysis, and making the fixes it points to
* Python tooling for testing, analysis and the range
* Debugging on hardware at weekly field tests

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2+ years writing production C++ that runs on real hardware or real-time systems
* Comfort below the abstraction layer: threading, concurrency, memory, performance profiling
* You implement, not just design. You’ve shipped code you wrote
* Evidence you learn fast: you got effective in a new domain in months, not years

**Where you probably come from:** We’re domain agnostic. Robotics, AV, drones, aerospace, F1 or automotive, maritime, embedded systems, compilers, or low-level C++ game engine and 3D simulation work all fit. A robotics degree isn’t required; the robotics is learnable on the job.

**We want to talk if:** You’ve written C++ where latency or timing actually mattered and you measured it. Bonus if your projects touch motion planning, dynamics, trajectory optimization, or state estimation.

**Not a fit if:** You’re web, backend or full stack; your C++ is light and your real work is in Python; you’ve never had a full-time role; or you design systems but don’t implement them.

**Nice to Haves:**

* ROS2 (a good signal, though we've moved past it)
* Rust or other systems languages
* Sensor integration and calibration
* Real-time Linux

**Education:** BS, MS or PhD in CS, EE, Robotics or equivalent. Track record matters more than degree.

**How You Operate:**

* Extreme bias for action. You'd rather build a prototype tomorrow than model it for a month
* You characterize your own systems before the field does
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a startup environment
* You debug from first principles, not intuition alone
* Clear communicator across mechanical, electrical, optical, and software teams
* Self directed. You identify what needs to happen next and do it without being told

**Why Join Aurelius Systems:**

* Build more in 1 month than most engineers build in 1 year. We field test weekly. Your work goes downrange, not into a filing cabinet.
* Career velocity is real. With no middle management, there are no layers between you and impact.
* Work on a problem that actually matters. Small cheap drones are changing warfare. Our laser systems are the asymmetric answer — infinite magazine, near zero cost per shot, scalable to every base, border, facility, and truck.
* Join the densest defense startup ecosystem in the country. California is where the next generation of defense companies are being built.

**How We Work:**

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9 to 6. When we're sprinting toward a demo or field test, the team ramps up — nights, weekends, whatever it takes to ship. When the sprint lands, we ramp down. We don't manufacture intensity for show. If you've worked at SpaceX, against a mission-critical timeline, or on a racing team, you already know the rhythm.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and equity
* United Health Care medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible 18 days PTO plus 5 sick days
* Travel to field test events and range days
* Covered daily lunches and office snacks and drinks
* E-bike and scooter stipend up to $500
* Direct access to leadership and real ownership over your work

**Export Control Notice:**

This role requires access to export-controlled information or items that require U.S. Person status. As defined by U.S. law, individuals who are any one of the following are considered to be a U.S. Person: (1) U.S. citizens, (2) legal permanent residents (a.k.a. green card holders), and (3) certain protected classes of asylees and refugees, as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Compensation Range: $145K - $185K

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
**About Bridge Neurotech**
--------------------------

Bridge Neurotech is building a non-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI-based neural decoding for brain-computer interface applications. We are a seed-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for an Electrical Engineering Lead to own the architecture strategy and delivery of the electronic systems behind Bridge’s custom ultrasound hardware: from system partitioning and component selection through schematic, layout, bring-up, and validated hardware.

Two design challenges sit at the center of this role. The first is high-speed I/O: moving raw acquisition data off the front-end over multi-gigabit-per-second links, with a focus on designing for signal integrity, clocking, and proper layout. The second is power delivery: multi-rail systems operating at watts of power, designed for efficiency and thermal headroom.

You will interface with ASICs at register level, write Python daily for bring-up and test automation, and know enough firmware to collaborate efficiently with our embedded systems team.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end electronics architecture of Bridge’s custom imaging hardware: system partitioning, component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout oversight, bring-up, and design validation.
* Design and deliver boards with multi-gigabit-per-second serial links (e.g., LVDS, JESD204, PCIe/USB 3.x-class SerDes), owning signal integrity, impedance control, clocking, and high-speed layout.
* Architect watts-class power delivery: multi-rail regulation, sequencing, efficiency, thermal design, and noise isolation for sensitive analog acquisition circuitry.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate ultrasound transmit/receive ASICs and analog front-ends: own the electrical interface to custom silicon and drive vendor relationships.
* Co-define the hardware/software boundary with the Embedded Systems Lead: digital interface definition, control plane, and data path. Write firmware where it accelerates bring-up.
* Build Python-based bring-up, characterization, and automated test tooling for every board revision.
* Lead board bring-up, debug, and failure analysis; manage PCB fabrication and assembly vendors and drive design reviews.
* Mentor the R&D Engineer, reviewing their schematics, layouts, and test methodology.
* Lay the documentation and design-control groundwork for eventual development in a regulated environment.

**Who you are**
---------------

**Required**

* Degree in electrical engineering or related field, with 6+ years of hands-on board-level design experience and multiple custom boards taken through production or production-equivalent builds.
* Extended experience with high-speed digital board design: multi-gigabit-per-second serial links, controlled-impedance routing, and signal/power integrity analysis.
* Demonstrated design of power delivery systems operating at watts of power: switching regulators, multi-rail architectures, sequencing, and thermal management.
* Working understanding of ASICs and how to interface with them: register-level configuration, electrical integration of custom silicon or analog front-ends, and informed dialogue with silicon vendors.
* Enough firmware fluency to write some embedded code yourself and work effectively day-to-day with an embedded systems engineer.
* Good command of Python for bring-up scripts, automated test, and data analysis.
* Experience from consumer electronics or other high-volume consumer products, where cost, manufacturability, and iteration speed were real constraints.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with hardware design in regulated environments (e.g., IEC 60601, design controls, medical or similar).
* Prior work on ultrasound, imaging, or other high-channel-count data acquisition front-ends, including AFE/ADC characterization.
* FPGA familiarity, enough to reason about the interface between your boards and programmable logic.
* EMC/EMI pre-compliance and debug experience.
* Early-stage startup experience where you set the hardware roadmap yourself.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to shape a role and a team from the earliest stages.
* Direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top-tier academic institutions.
* Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k).

Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
**About Poseidon Aerospace:**
-----------------------------

Poseidon Aerospace is reimagining how the world moves goods. We build and operate full-size autonomous cargo aircraft - capable of carrying two tons of payload over a thousand nautical miles. From remote communities to contested logistics operations, our platforms unlock a new cost curve for air freight, making it faster, cheaper, and accessible anywhere it's needed. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with locations in Washington DC, Oregon, and Maine; we're building something consequential.

**About the role**
------------------

Flight software is the code that runs on the flight computers of our autonomous cargo aircraft. As a Senior Flight Software Engineer you will own major parts of that software, from architecture through flight test. You will decide how the software is structured, how it handles failures, and how it is tested, and you will write a large share of the code yourself. You will also set the technical bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the architecture of major flight software subsystems, including timing, partitioning, and redundancy
* Design and implement deterministic, real-time embedded flight software in C++
* Design fault detection and response for the aircraft, including redundancy management, degraded modes, and lost-link behavior
* Define software requirements and interfaces with avionics, GNC, and flight test, and trace them to tests
* Implement the GNC team’s algorithms in flight code and verify them against simulation
* Set the test strategy across unit tests, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop
* Build telemetry, logging, and command paths between the aircraft and the ground station
* Lead software integration on the aircraft and support ground testing and flight test, including travel to our flight test site
* Set coding standards and review practices, and lead design reviews
* Mentor other flight software engineers

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* B.S. in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of professional C or C++ development on embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems
* Owned a flight software subsystem or equivalent from architecture through fielded operation
* Took software through hardware integration and test on a real vehicle (aircraft, spacecraft, or automotive)
* Designed fault detection and response for a system where failure had safety consequences
* Led design reviews and set technical direction for other engineers

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Flight software experience on crewed or uncrewed aircraft, or on spacecraft
* RTOS or bare-metal development, with a deep understanding of scheduling, timing, and memory
* Experience designing redundant or fault-tolerant flight computer architectures
* Experience developing software under DO-178C or a comparable standard such as ISO 26262
* Experience supporting flight test or vehicle test campaigns
* Python for tooling, test automation, and flight data analysis

**Why this role**
-----------------

Flight software touches every system on the aircraft: avionics, propulsion, flight controls, and the ground station. You will make the decisions that shape how those systems work together, at a stage where the architecture is still yours to set. You will work directly with flight hardware and watch your code fly an aircraft that carries two tons.

**What you get from us**
------------------------

* Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity
* Relocation support if applicable
* Employee Health Benefit Plans
* 6% Retirement matching
* Flexible PTO
* Free lunches, snacks, and a stocked fridge at our offices

**General Summary:**

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G — ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age — and this is where you come in.

  
  

The MMODE team develops protocol software that enables intelligent system selection and mobility across terrestrial and satellite wireless networks. MMODE software determines how devices discover, select, acquire, and transition between available connectivity options while balancing user experience, network performance, power efficiency, and operator requirements. Engineers work on technologies including 5G NR, LTE, NTN, Multi-SIM, emergency services, and next-generation connectivity solutions, collaborating closely with systems, modem firmware, and test teams to deliver innovative wireless features.

  
  

As a Modem Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize real-time embedded software for Qualcomm's modem subsystem (MPSS). You will work close to the metal — writing performant, resource-constrained C/C++ that runs on DSP and Arm cores across cellular protocol layers, device drivers, and RTOS-level components.

  
  

Beyond traditional embedded development, this role is explicitly **AI-native** . You are expected to leverage, build, and improve AI-assisted development workflows — using code-generation agents, LLM-based code review, automated test synthesis, log/crash triage assistants, and retrieval-augmented tooling over our codebase — to dramatically accelerate delivery, quality, and debugging in a highly complex firmware environment.

**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

The Agentic Runtime team builds the low‑latency, reliable, and secure foundation that powers Glean’s AI agents and assistant experiences at scale. You’ll design and operate core runtime services for multi‑turn orchestration, tool calling, model routing, memory, streaming, and safety. You’ll work across distributed systems, production observability, and ML infra integrations to deliver an experience that feels instant, accurate, and trustworthy — while optimizing cost and reliability.

**You will:**

* Own impactful runtime problems end‑to‑end — from architecture and design to production launch and ongoing reliability.
* Build and evolve core services for session lifecycle, streaming responses (e.g., gRPC/WebSockets), structured tool execution, memory/state, and policy/guardrails.
* Design for performance, correctness, and cost: reduce p50/p95 latency, improve tail behavior, and optimize token/tool budgets.
* Integrate with leading LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) and internal evaluation frameworks to improve quality and predictability.
* Harden the platform with fault isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit‑breaking, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Instrument deep observability (tracing, metrics, logs) and create playbooks/SLOs for high availability and on‑call excellence.
* Collaborate closely with product, quality, and application teams to prioritize the most impactful roadmap investments.

**You are:**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems or cloud‑native applications.
* BS/BA in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong coding skills in at least one of: Python, Go, Java, Javascript, Typescript, C++, with a focus on reliability, performance, and tests.
* Product‑minded: you prioritize customer impact, clear SLAs/SLOs, and pragmatic iteration.
* Ownership‑driven with a positive, proactive attitude; comfortable leading projects or learning from battle‑tested engineers.

* Experience operating services on Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure).
* Familiarity with event/streaming systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka), caching (e.g., Redis), and data stores for low‑latency paths.
* Practical understanding of LLM/agents building blocks: tool/function calling, structured outputs, streaming, and model selection/routing.
* Strong observability and debugging skills: tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry), metrics, dashboards, and production forensics.
* Background in one or more areas is a plus: policy/guardrails, multi‑tenant isolation, rate‑limiting, concurrency control, cost optimization.

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer, High Voltage Power Electronics for Motor Drives
jobs.description:
*Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

Neon Aero is seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer in Irvine, California. The Principal Engineer, High Voltage Power Electronics for Motor Drives provides technical leadership in the architecture, design, and qualification of high voltage motor drives for aerospace and advanced mobility applications. This is a deeply hands-on role: the engineer personally develops architectures, block diagrams, schematics, and the analysis behind them, and owns the rationale for every major design decision across drives from 1 kW to 100 kW, on DC buses from 270 V to 800 V (up to 1000 V), powered by batteries in applications such as eVTOL and by turbogenerator systems. The role collaborates closely with motor control, embedded software, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, and supply chain teams, and provides strong technical leadership, ownership, and mentoring of other engineers without direct people management responsibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

Architecture and Power Stage Design

* Own architecture and design of HV motor drives in two classes: 1 to 3 kW convection-cooled, and 3 to 100 kW liquid or forced-air cooled.
* Design inverter power stages for 270 V to 800 V buses (up to 1000 V): device selection (SiC, GaN, Si), gate drive, protection, and sensing.
* Develop PMSM drive hardware, applying motor control fundamentals to select feedback sensors, current sensing, switching frequency, and processors.
* Design input DM/CM filters and size DC link capacitors for ripple, stability, and lifetime.

EMI, Grounding, and Thermal Design

* Define shielding, grounding, and bonding for motors, cables, and enclosures to contain switching noise.
* Own thermal and EMI design for integrated motor and controller units in a single enclosure.
* Select components, processors, and HV connectors for high-vibration, extended-temperature aviation and defense environments.

Analysis, Validation, and Qualification

* Personally perform loss, thermal, stress, derating, insulation, EMI, and worst-case analyses.
* Develop schematics and review layouts for high dv/dt power stages (creepage, clearance, commutation loops, partial discharge).
* Lead bring-up, validation, and root cause investigations in the lab.
* Support DO-160 and MIL-STD-461 qualification and transition designs into production.

Manufacturing and Mentorship

* Drive DFM, DFT, and DFA; define manufacturing test requirements, coverage, and end-of-line test strategy.
* Mentor EEs developing 28 V and 48 V motor drive controllers.

**Qualifications**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or related field; equivalent experience considered.
* Minimum of 12 years designing and shipping power electronics, including multiple motor drives or high power converters.
* Hands-on design experience at both low power (1 to 3 kW) and high power (up to about 100 kW).
* Direct experience with HV DC buses (270 V to 800 V, up to 1000 V).
* Depth in at least one of automotive, industrial, aviation, or defense at comparable complexity.
* Expertise in inverter power stages, device selection, gate drive, DC link, and EMI filter design.
* Working knowledge of PMSM drives, FOC, feedback sensors, and current sensing.
* Strong grounding, shielding, and noise containment practice for motor, cable, and enclosure systems.
* Proficiency with Altium (or equivalent) and circuit simulation (SPICE, PLECS, or similar).

Preferred Experience

* SiC or GaN power stage design at high dv/dt and high switching frequency.
* Electric propulsion, eVTOL, hybrid-electric, or turbogenerator systems.
* Integrated motor and controller designs sharing one enclosure and cooling system.
* Insulation coordination and partial discharge at altitude for high voltage aircraft systems.
* High voltage connectors and harnesses for aviation or defense (high vibration, extended temperature).
* Familiarity with DO-160, DO-254, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-704, ARP4754B, or similar standards.
* Python or MATLAB for analysis, automation, or test scripts.
* Fault-tolerant, high-reliability design experience (preferred, not required).

**What We Value**

* Engineers who have designed and shipped power electronics repeatedly.
* First-principles depth combined with practical, hands-on execution.
* Clear rationale behind every part selected and every design decision.
* High standards for reliability, manufacturability, and cost discipline.
* Technical leadership through mentoring, not formal authority, including growing EEs working on 28 V or 48 V motor drive controllers.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity while driving clarity for others.

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside elite engineering talent and innovators from across aerospace and tech.
* Be part of a team moving faster than the industry standard.
* Shape solutions that are lower-cost, autonomous, and scalable — the future of aviation.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation, growth opportunities, and full health benefits (health, vision, dental, 401(k)) designed to support you in and out of work.

NVIDIA is rapidly growing our research and development for Deep Learning Inference and is seeking excellent Software Engineers at all levels of expertise to join our team. Companies around the world are using NVIDIA GPUs to power a revolution in deep learning, enabling breakthroughs in areas like Generative AI, Recommenders and Vision that have put DL into every software solution. Join the team that builds the software to enable the performance optimization, deployment and serving of these DL inference solutions. We specialize in developing GPU-accelerated deep learning inference software like TensorRT, DL benchmarking software and performant solutions to deploy and serve these models.

Collaborate with the deep learning community to integrate TensorRT into OSS frameworks like TensorRT-EdgeLLM and PyTorch. Identify performance opportunities and optimize SoTA models across the spectrum of NVIDIA accelerators, from datacenter GPUs to edge SoCs. **What you'll be doing:**

* Establish groundbreaking performance benchmarking methodologies and analysis workflows and identify performance issues and opportunities for NVIDIA’s inference ecosystem (e.g. TensorRT/TensorRT-EdgeLLM/Torch-TensorRT)
* Contribute features and code to NVIDIA/OSS inference frameworks including but not limited to TensorRT/TensorRT-EdgeLLM/Torch-TensorRT.
* Develop new model pipelines for NVIDIA’s inference ecosystem with optimized performance including but not limited to areas like quantization, scheduling, memory management, and distributed inference to set the gold standard for Gen AI performance.
* Work with cross-collaborative teams inside and outside of NVIDIA across generative AI, automotive, robotics, image understanding, and speech understanding to set directions and develop innovative inference solutions.
* Scale performance of deep learning models across different architectures and types of NVIDIA accelerators.

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelors, Masters, PhD, or equivalent experience in relevant fields (Computer Science, Computer Engineering, EECS, AI).
* 2 years of relevant software development experience.
* Strong C++, Python programming and software engineering skills
* Experience with DL frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, ONNX) and inference libraries (e.g. TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, FlashInfer).
* Experience with performance analysis and performance optimization

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Strong foundation and architectural knowledge of GPUs.
* Deep understanding of modern deep learning models and workloads (e.g. Transformers, Recommenders, ASR, TTS, Visual Understanding).
* Proficiency in one of the deep learning programming domain specific languages (e.g. CUDA/TileIR/CuTeDSL/cutlass/Triton).
* Prior contributions to major LLM inference frameworks (e.g. vLLM) or prior experience with graph compilers in deep learning inference (e.g. TorchDynamo/TorchInductor).
* Prior experience optimizing performance for low-latency, resource-constrained systems or embedded AI pipelines (e.g. Jetson systems or other edge AI accelerators).

GPU deep learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason and solve problems posed using human language. This may explain why NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for deep learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” Come, join our DL Architecture team, where you can help build a real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

We provide flight software and systems engineering for the design and implementation of spacecraft for the laboratory's key flight projects. We provide leadership and specialized expertise in developing flight software and systems engineering for spacecraft, small satellites, and instrument payloads.

As a **Flight Software Engineer IV**, you will be working for JPL’s **Flight Software and Systems Engineering Section**, which provides leadership and specialized expertise in developing flight software and systems engineering for spacecraft, small satellites, and instrument payloads.

As a key member of the **Flight Software Architecture and Infrastructure Group,** you will perform software engineering activities associated with the delivery of embedded flight software products for small scale projects developing CubeSats, small satellites and spacecraft payloads where the typical flight software team sizes are between one and five people.

Mostly a software engineering assignment would involve the development of complex and mission critical embedded software for spacecraft, including software requirements definition, software design, code development, peer review, documentation, thorough unit testing, integration testing using simulations and avionics hardware, and defect resolution to JPL flight mission customers.
