### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience in data center systems, linux, data center networking, machine automation, ML hardware, and strong debugging and technical troubleshooting skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Core Systems and Capacity Assurance (CSCA) Team is responsible for the journey of a new system from the point of manufacturing to data center delivery. We do this on projects that push the limits of technologies and provide you with an opportunity to make a broad impact across all of Google's product families. The technologies include systems that support machine learning, video transcoding, security, general compute, image processing, and storage. jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Compute
jobs.description:
**About Neuralink:**

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

**Team Description:**

Neuralink's Information Technology team owns the corporate environment that every engineer, scientist, and clinician depends on to do their work. Within IT, the Compute function is responsible for the physical and server infrastructure that powers neural recording training, data processing, and engineering workloads: the data center floor itself, the GPU and HPC clusters that run on it, and the storage, provisioning, and monitoring that keep those systems healthy. We build this infrastructure from the ground up, manage it as code, and treat uptime for research workloads as production.

**Job Description and Responsibilities:**

Neuralink is looking for a hands-on Systems Engineer with deep expertise in data center design, build, and operations. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our compute and storage infrastructure, from site buildout and hardware procurement through deployment, automation, and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate brings equal comfort on the data center floor and at the keyboard, thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, and has a passion for building reliable, scalable systems from the ground up. The job responsibilities will include:

* Design, build, and operate data center environments including power infrastructure (PDUs, UPS, generators), cooling systems (CRAC/CRAH, liquid cooling), and scalable racking; drive capacity planning for power, cooling, and floor space
* Own the full server and storage lifecycle: hardware selection and procurement, rack and cable, commissioning with BIOS/firmware tuning and integration testing, maintenance, and decommission
* Administer and manage HPC and GPU clusters and high-performance storage systems
* Automate server provisioning using PXE/HTTP boot, scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python), and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Puppet
* Administer Linux and Windows server environments including OS deployment, patching, hardening, and performance tuning
* Operate infrastructure monitoring and alerting; drive capacity planning for compute and storage from the data
* Plan and coordinate maintenance windows, upgrades, and expansions; maintain 24/7 on-call readiness for compute and storage incidents
* Ensure all systems comply with HIPAA, PII handling requirements, and applicable cybersecurity standards (ISO, NIST)
* Author and maintain systems design documents, rack and power diagrams, runbooks, SOPs, hardware inventory, and DCIM records

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience building and supporting HPC or high-density compute environments: GPU clusters, high-performance storage
* Hands-on experience with data center power, cooling, and racking design and operations
* Strong Linux server administration experience; working knowledge of Windows Server
* Experience automating bare-metal provisioning (PXE/HTTP boot) and configuration management with Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet
* Familiarity with DCIM tools and infrastructure monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and NTP as they apply to server deployment and troubleshooting
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field OR equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with cluster resource managers (Slurm, LSF, PBS)
* Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/Proxmox) and storage ecosystems (NAS/SAN, NFS/iSCSI)
* Hands-on experience deploying liquid-cooled GPU racks
* Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry environments
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD for infrastructure pipelines
* Industry certifications such as CDCP, RHCE, or equivalent data center and Linux certifications

**What We Offer:**

Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits listed below.

* An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields
* Growth potential; we rapidly advance team members who have an outsized impact
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan
* Paid holidays
* Commuter benefits
* Meals provided
* Equity (RSUs) *\*Temporary Employees & Interns excluded*
* 401(k) plan *\*Interns initially excluded until they work 1,000 hours*
* Parental leave *\*Temporary Employees & Interns excluded*
* Flexible time off *\*Temporary Employees & Interns excluded*

**Summary**

The Robotics Engineer designs, programs, and commissions industrial robot workcells on Deterrence's automated production line in the Dallas area. jobs.description:

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)
jobs.description:
**Title:** Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)

**Hours:** Full-time

**Location:** Midvale, UT (On-site with occasional remote flexibility) #LI-Onsite

**You report to:** Software Engineering Manager

**Compensation:** A base salary range of $120,000-$135,000 gross per year, depending on candidate experience.

**Our Benefits:**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with BioLite covering 90–100% of monthly premiums, depending on plan selection.
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Paid Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, sick time, and family leave to support work-life balance.
* Equity & Bonus Opportunities: Community bonus plan and stock option eligibility for all full-time employees.
* Adventure Stipend (after two years): PTO to go on an adventure that aligns with BioLite's mission of bringing energy everywhere, whether that's outdoor recreation, climate action, or social impact.
* Employee Product Discount: Employees enjoy generous discounts on BioLite and Goal Zero products.

  

**This Role:**

BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Midvale-based team. In this role, you will develop the firmware that connects our power products to the cloud (AWS IoT) and to our Flutter and React Native mobile apps. You will work on the wireless connectivity modules in our home backup and portable power products. These modules work alongside battery management, inverter, and power conversion subsystems. You will focus on provisioning, OTA updates, device-to-cloud messaging, fleet telemetry, and the protocols among modules in the rest of the system. Our current products use the ESP32, and you will help choose and bring up the wireless platform for our next generation of products. Options we are looking at include embedded Rust (Embassy), embedded Linux, and smart home standards such as Matter and Thread.

A large part of this job is making existing firmware better. You will refactor, add tests, and pay down technical debt so the team ships faster with fewer field issues. You will work with firmware, electrical, cloud, and mobile engineers. You will debug at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and your code will run on devices in homes and in the field.

**You Will:**

* **Develop connectivity-module firmware:** Develop and maintain firmware for our Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity modules, including provisioning, configuration, OTA updates, and device-to-cloud messaging.
* **Improve the codebase you inherit:** Refactor existing firmware, add unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests, and set coding standards that make changes safe and code reviews fast.
* **Build communication protocols:** Develop the protocol libraries that connect our subsystems (battery management, inverter, IoT module) to each other and to the mobile app.
* **Lead the firmware build and release pipeline:** Maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions for firmware builds, tests, and releases for your projects. Make OTA releases reliable and traceable.
* **Work across the device-to-cloud path:** Work with cloud and mobile engineers on device APIs (AWS IoT), fleet telemetry, and app integration. Debug issues end-to-end, from the radio to the app.
* **Use modern tools:** Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up prototyping, debugging, testing, and documentation.
* **Review and document:** Take part in code and design reviews. Document designs for other developers, QA, manufacturing partners, and support.

  

**You Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; OR 5+ years of directly relevant experience.
* 3+ years writing production firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers or SoCs (e.g., Espressif ESP32, Nordic nRF, ST STM32, or other Arm Cortex-M).
* Experience with a real-time operating system (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and a wireless vendor SDK (e.g., ESP-IDF, nRF Connect SDK).
* Working knowledge of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and an IoT messaging protocol such as MQTT.
* Working knowledge of bootloaders, OTA updates, and device provisioning.
* Working knowledge of serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Experience testing embedded code (unit tests, simulation, or hardware-in-the-loop).
* Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for build, test, and tooling scripts.
* Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD.
* Experience with AI coding assistants in your daily work.

  

**Nice to Have:**

You do not need the following skills to apply, but please let us know if you have experience in any of these areas.

* Experience with AWS IoT Core or another cloud IoT platform, including REST APIs.
* Experience with mobile app development (native, Flutter, or React Native).
* Experience with smart home protocols such as Matter, Thread, Zigbee, or Z-Wave.
* Experience with or interest in embedded Rust (e.g., Embassy) or embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot).
* Experience with fleet monitoring, device telemetry, or crash reporting.
* Experience with consumer electronics, batteries, or power conversion.

  

**To Apply:**

* Please include a cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for this position. Feel free to link or describe a relevant personal project, hobby build, or open-source contribution that highlights your firmware or software skills.
* **You must be authorized to work for an employer in the U.S.** BioLite cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position.

  

**About BioLite:**

BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces to power life, anywhere. Together, we provide clean energy solutions that serve two distinct yet connected markets: families living in energy poverty and outdoor adventurers seeking fuel-independent power and light. From solar panels and portable power stations to cookstoves and lighting systems, our technologies help people cook, charge, and stay connect

This is achieved by leveraging our organization's collective expertise through collaborative development processes, which include thorough design and peer reviews. We can deliver innovative, high-performance solutions that meet our customers' evolving requirements by integrating our specialized knowledge in aerospace electronic systems with appropriately scaled development methodologies.

We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and evolution of the software platforms that control our automated electronic test and support systems. This role owns the technical direction and architecture of reusable software frameworks that serve both engineering development and production test environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern Python software engineering, asynchronous systems programming, hardware communications, and software architecture. You will define, build, and continuously improve the core GSE software platform that enables reliable, maintainable, and scalable automated test and support systems across multiple programs and product lines.

You will collaborate closely with the Lead Test Systems Engineer, Integration & Test engineers, the Engineering Systems Integration Engineer, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the GSE software platform aligns with organizational needs and supports long-term engineering infrastructure.

Success in this role is measured by:

* Robustness, stability, and maintainability of the core platform
* Reliability and uptime of production test operations
* Measurable productivity gains for engineering and test teams
* Effective reuse of frameworks across projects and programs
* The ability to support increasingly sophisticated automated GSE and test systems

What Makes This Role Distinct?

This is not a QA automation or web application role. The Senior GSE Software Engineer:

* Defines and owns the reusable software platform that powers automated electronic test systems and Ground Support Equipment.
* Sets the technical direction and architecture for long-lived engineering infrastructure supporting multiple products and programs.
* Operates at the intersection of software engineering, hardware control, and systems integration to enable sophisticated, mission-critical automated test and support operations.

In this role, you will be the technical leader ensuring that our GSE software platform is robust, extensible, and capable of supporting increasingly complex automated systems—directly influencing engineering efficiency, product quality, and production reliability.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

Technical Leadership & Architecture

* Define the overarching GSE software platform architecture, including standards, design principles, and best practices.
* Design scalable asynchronous software architectures for concurrent control of instruments and support equipment.
* Lead the development of reusable Python frameworks that underpin automated GSE and test systems.
* Establish clear abstractions, interfaces, and patterns for instruments, communication buses, and test procedures.
* Evaluate and select tools, libraries, and technologies for the GSE software stack, providing well-reasoned recommendations and tradeoff analyses.

Framework & Platform Development

* Develop reusable instruments and communication abstractions that can be applied consistently across diverse projects and test systems.
* Architect and implement execution frameworks for sequencing, scheduling, concurrency, error handling, logging, and health monitoring.
* Design and build measurement acquisition, data processing, and results management software integrated with enterprise engineering tools and data systems.
* Implement robust configuration, deployment, and monitoring mechanisms for GSE software in both laboratory and production environments.

System Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with the Lead Test Systems Engineer to co-develop the framework architecture that underpins all automated test systems.
* Work with Integration & Test engineers to translate I&T requirements into reliable, maintainable automated test procedures on the GSE platform.
* Collaborate with the Engineering Systems Integration Engineer to integrate GSE software with enterprise systems (e.g., engineering databases, PLM, configuration management, data repositories).
* Provide expert support to production test operations, including diagnosing complex system issues, improving performance, and enhancing reliability.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

* Champion professional software engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and configuration management.
* Mentor and coach software and test engineers in asynchronous programming, software architecture, and best practices for automated test and GSE systems.
* Drive continuous improvement in coding standards, design guidelines, and development workflows for the GSE software ecosystem.
* Lead root-cause analysis efforts for complex GSE software issues and implement durable corrective actions that improve system behavior over time.

jobs.description:
The Software Engineer III is a key technical contributor within Oceaneering Technologies (OTECH), responsible for driving software development efforts that support one‑of‑a‑kind underwater systems built for U.S. Navy and other DoW customers. Engineers at this level apply deep understanding of the software lifecycle to design system architectures, lead or significantly contribute to project software activities, and ensure delivered solutions satisfy electrical, mechanical, and operational (CONOPS) needs while collaborating closely with engineering leads, project managers, and external customers.

Beyond feature leadership, this role executes hands‑on systems software work across Linux‑based distributed and embedded environments—implementing system services and application components; building hardware/software interfaces and device drivers; enabling data‑processing functions; and delivering robust communications capabilities. Typical development spans native Linux and containerized deployments (e.g., Docker/Podman) with orchestration via Kubernetes, and leverages DDS‑based publish/subscribe messaging for real‑time, mission‑critical data exchange—consistent with OTECH integration‑lab practices and container/DDS orchestration patterns.

Engineers will participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements implementation, software design, coding, unit and integration testing, debugging, peer reviews, configuration management, and technical documentation. The role benefits from a systems‑programming foundation (memory/resource management, multithreading/concurrency, IPC, networking, and efficient data structures) and facility with modern toolchains and build systems (GCC/Clang, Cargo, CMake), debugging and analysis tools (GDB, sanitizers), and structured data formats (JSON, XML). Work products are supported by CI/CD pipelines and automated testing to ensure reliability and repeatability; engineers frequently contribute to test harnesses and lab workflows that validate containerized services and DDS participants under failure‑recovery and health‑check scenarios.

Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, the ability to see the big picture, and a capacity to devise innovative solutions when conventional approaches fall short. Engineers are expected to mentor junior developers, support proposal and design trade studies, and participate in software testing across factory floor, offsite, and offshore environments—developing solutions that integrate seamlessly with sensors, SBC‑based control systems, and mission operations while meeting documentation and CDRL acceptance criteria consistent with OTECH standards.

* Foundational understanding of Linux system programming.

Must be a U.S. citizen.

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

Responsibilities include defining requirements, coordinating development, testing and validating completed software, troubleshooting field issues, and supporting releases throughout the product lifecycle.

The role supports embedded controls, touchscreen interfaces, connected applications, Microsoft Azure cloud services, APIs, databases, and wireless connectivity. Most major software development is performed by external partners; however, the engineer must have sufficient software experience to understand and troubleshoot code, evaluate proposed solutions, and perform smaller software or firmware updates when appropriate.

* Lead assigned software projects from requirements through development, validation, release, and field support.
* Translate product, customer, service, and engineering needs into clear software requirements, scopes of work, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate priorities, schedules, technical issues, defects, and releases with third-party software developers.

* Troubleshoot software and connectivity issues found during engineering testing, manufacturing, or on equipment installed in the field.
* Use telemetry, logs, diagnostic information, and laboratory testing to identify root cause and corrective actions.
* Support Wi-Fi connectivity and customer cybersecurity requirements, including security questionnaires, trust-center reviews, and technical discussions with customer IT organizations.

100% on site role interacting with production and other departments

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 2+ years of professional experience in software development, embedded systems, connected products, or software systems engineering.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Working knowledge or experience with several of the following:

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ever wondered how Amazon keeps hundreds of fulfillment centers running at peak performance across the globe? That's where our team comes in.  
  
We build the real-time data platform that gives Amazon's fulfillment network end-to-end visibility — from conveyor belts and robotic systems to software applications and workforce operations. Think of it as the central nervous system for Amazon's physical logistics: we ingest millions of data points per second from equipment and systems across 100+ facilities worldwide, store years of historical data without sacrificing query speed, and serve it all up through dashboards, APIs, and SDKs that help teams detect problems before they happen, optimize processes in real time, and make smarter decisions about how to move packages faster.  
  
What makes this role different:  
  
This isn't a typical web services role. You'll work at the intersection of physical operations and cloud-scale software — solving problems where hardware unpredictability meets distributed systems challenges. The data you help collect and serve directly impacts whether a package gets delivered on time, whether equipment gets serviced before it breaks, and whether an entire facility runs smoothly on its busiest day of the year.  
  
You'll own problems end-to-end, from system design through production operations, and your work will be visible in real-world outcomes across Amazon's global logistics network.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll design and build distributed systems that operate at massive scale — processing high-velocity time-series data streams, building storage layers that balance performance with cost, and creating APIs that make complex data accessible to thousands of users. Right now, we're in the middle of a major storage architecture migration, rethinking how we handle hot data to improve reliability and reduce latency. You'll also have the opportunity to work on data ingestion pipelines that collect signals from industrial hardware, robotics, and software systems — and turn that raw telemetry into actionable insights.

Company Overview:

**Verathon** is a global medical device company focused on supporting customers by being their trusted partner, delivering high-quality products that endure over time and ensure clinical and economic utility. Two areas where Verathon has significantly impacted patient care, and become the market leader in each, are bladder volume measurement and airway management. The company’s BladderScan portable ultrasound and GlideScope video laryngoscopy & bronchoscopy systems effectively address unmet needs for healthcare providers and meaningfully raise the standard of care for patients. Verathon, a subsidiary of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, USA and has international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.

Overview:

**Verathon®** is looking for an Electrical Engineer III to become the newest member of our Urology R&D team located in Bothell, WA. This role is expected to work primarily on-site at our Bothell facility and will design and develop electronic systems and components including camera, lighting, and circuit board systems, for an exciting new program targeted at improving patient outcomes in a urological endoscopy procedure - offering the opportunity to shape our newest urology product within Verathon's established new product development (NPD) framework.

The Electrical Engineer III is responsible for the electronic design, analysis, and development of complex medical device systems. This includes translating system requirements into detailed circuit and PCB designs, conducting engineering analysis across analog and digital domains, developing and testing prototypes, supporting design verification and validation activities, and ensuring designs meet EMI/EMC requirements and regulatory compliance standards. Utilizing Verathon's NPD process and Quality Management System, the Electrical Engineer III serves as a core technical contributor working closely with systems engineering, mechanical engineering, firmware, manufacturing, and quality teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as a core technical contributor on major development projects or multiple simultaneous projects, working independently with review at critical points
* Ensure that engineering design activities follow the development procedure and maintain strict design control
* Develop electronic systems and documentation in compliance with applicable medical device standards, regulatory requirements, and Verathon design control procedures.
* Interact with internal and external stakeholders, component vendors, and contract manufacturers to design for manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness
* Adapt communication style to differing technical and non-technical audiences
* Design robust analog and digital multilayer PCBs and flex circuits.
* Investigate design approaches, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions to complex technical problems through analysis, prototyping, and bench testing..
* Support project scope, proposals, and expense controls. Develop business justifications and cost proposals for capital equipment, prototyping, and V&V activities.
* Integrate and interface specific subsystem technologies including camera and imaging sensors, other sensor interfaces, LED lighting drive circuits, power conversion, microprocessors, data storage, and high-speed interfaces into complex multilayer rigid, flex, and hybrid PCB designs
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex EMI/EMC issues; apply design techniques for impedance control and electromagnetic compatibility to meet regulatory emissions and immunity requirements
* Mentor team members and share technical knowledge through formal and informal collaboration

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a relevant engineering field of study is required.

* Experience with flex PCB technology, high-density interconnect (HDI) design, RF/high-speed signal design, or FPGA integration is preferred.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Training/Inference (C++)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **About the Role:**

* We are building the high-performance inference platform that serves Grok to millions of users every day with lightning speed and perfect reliability.
* As a Member of Technical Staff - Inference, you will design and optimize large-scale model serving systems end-to-end. You will own everything from distributed infrastructure (global KV cache, continuous batching, load balancing, auto-scaling) to deep low-level optimizations (GPU kernels, quantization, speculative decoding, tail latency).
* This is a high-impact role where your work directly determines how fast and reliably users interact with Grok at massive scale

**Responsibilities:**

* Architect and implement scalable distributed infrastructure for model serving (load balancing, auto-scaling, batch scheduling, global KV cache).

As the most senior individual contributor, you will work on our hardest problems, help establish technical standards, NativeAI development practices, and drive the overall technical architecture for products that delight our customers.
  
  
The Devices Financial System Automation (DFSA) team owns the consolidated technical architecture that transforms how Devices & Services (D&S) businesses set up and operate their financial systems. D&S launches a fast-growing portfolio — Alexa, Fire TV, Ring, Blink, eero, Kindle, Appstore, Amazon Smart Vehicles, and more — and every new business launch requires financial record-keeping (FRK) setup spanning the entire fintech domains from contract review, business requirements, tax classification, accounting entries, billing and payments. DFSA partners with teams across the Amazon's D&S division to accelerate new product launches.
  
  
Architecting agentic primitives at scale is central to our strategy. We are building a Gen AI–powered automation platform that takes a product idea or partner deal from initial idea to a live, automated financial record-keeping capabilities in days to weeks — using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-agent orchestration workflows. These solutions draft contracts, requirements, engineering specifications, and code that previously took teams months to produce. As Principal Engineer, you will define and drive the multi-year, architecture for this platform: unifying fragmented workflows into scalable, flexible, and compliant FinTech solutions, and setting the technical direction for how Gen AI is applied safely and accurately across financial systems. This is a strategic investment adopted not just by the Devices & Services organization, but also teams across Digital, Ads and Consumer groups. You will shape the strategy that accelerates timelines from months to days, enabling every D&S business to launch and monetize faster.  
  
Another core dependency for accelerating Devices product development lifecycle from months to days requires providing agentic and builder access to Amazon's diverse portfolio of Devices throughout the build process. We provide 16 businesses across Devices, Ads, and Digital teams elastic device capacity and operate as the singular entry point for every device type and setup at Amazon. Amazon Device Farm services provide the device signal that fuels the fast feedback loops autonomous agentic systems and builders need for product development - providing agents and builders unified, elastic device capacity, configured on demand, with the functionality, reliability, and scale teams require to ship products to customers faster and to higher quality.
  
  
As a core leader in the Devices Global Retail Tech org, you'll work to simplify and accelerate Devices and Services product launches across every Product Line (FireTV, Kindle, Alexa, echo, eero, Leo, and more) as well as key partners in Digital, Ads and Consumer teams by driving the architecture and agentic solutions that remove existing constraints spanning diverse problem domains.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:  
  

* Serve as a technical leader on our most demanding, cross-functional projects, owning the consolidated, Gen AI–powered system architecture that solves key fintech problems across all of D&S and Set the technical vision and direction for the org's fintech space

  

* Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions — designing for reuse across 12+ product lines and multiple geographies rather than one-off integrations.

  

* Possess and apply expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, and engineering best practices, with financial accuracy, auditability, and tax/regulatory compliance treated as first-class architectural concerns — ensuring Gen AI outputs are grounded, verifiable, and compliant.

  

* Understand the evolving needs of the D&S business and partner deeply with stakeholders across Business Development, Finance, Product, Tech, Accounting, and Tax to translate those needs into durable technical strategy.

  

* Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. You are a technical thought leader, builder, and operator.

  

* Balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices, sequencing a pragmatic roadmap that delivers incremental value while converging on the target-state consolidated system.

  

* Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues — including Gen AI engineering best practices — and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

* 12+ years of software development experience, including designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems.

  

* Experience serving as a technical leader across product and tech teams, driving architecture and technical strategy.

  

* Expert knowledge of performance, scalability, and enterprise system architecture.

  

* Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders and align diverse teams behind a common direction.

Echodyne offers the world's first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Our Data Platform connects sensors and radars through EchoWare to cloud services and internal data systems. jobs.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra's solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Systems Engineering Manager facilitates the execution of strategic product development objectives by providing both technical leadership and direct systems engineering contributions across the product development lifecycle. This role leads a small team of Systems Engineers while actively participating in system architecture, requirements development, risk management, system integration, and verification activities. The Systems Engineering Manager partners closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer, clinical, business, and regulatory requirements into robust medical device solutions while continuously improving systems engineering processes, tools, and best practices.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**  

* Leads and develops the Systems Engineering team.
* Generates and analyzes system architectures, requirements, and risk management artifacts.
* Communicates and coordinates with cross-functional teams.
* Provides technical leadership for system integration, verification, validation, and problem resolution.
* Advises teams on systems engineering tools, methods, and standards.
* Monitors work to ensure technical quality, effective execution, and schedule adherence.

**COMPETENCIES**  

* Passion: Contagious excitement about the company – sense of urgency. Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Integrity: Commitment, accountability, and dedication to the highest ethical standards.
* Collaboration/Teamwork: Inclusion of Team Member regardless of geography, position, and product or service.
* Action/Results: High energy, decisive planning, timely execution.
* Innovation: Generation of new ideas from original thinking.
* Customer Focus: Exceed customer expectations, quality of products, services, and experience always present of mind.
* Emotional Intelligence: Recognizes, understands, manages one's own emotions and is able to influence others. A critical skill for pressure situations.

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional engineering teams.
* Direct experience with requirements development, traceability management, risk management, system architecture, and verification activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**  

* Previous people management experience.
* Direct experience developing regulated medical devices.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 14971, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, and FDA design control requirements.

* Indoor open office environment
* Minimal noise volume typical to an office environment
* Extended hours when needed
* Kestra manufactures and provides life-saving products regulated by the Federal Food and Drug Administration and under contract with Medicare. Kestra maintains a drug free workplace and testing is a condition of employment post-offer.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**  

* Frequent repetitive motions that may include wrists, hands and/or fingers, such as keyboard and mouse usage
* Frequent stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time
* Frequent computer use
* Frequent phone and other business machine use
* Occasional lifting required, typically between 2-15 pounds

**TRAVEL**  

* Occasional travel may be required, 10%

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

### **Job Details**

##### **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

**INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

  
  

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

  
  

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

  
  

The Sr. Electronics Engineering Technician will support new product design teams through test development, data analysis and competitor benchmarking. You will independently plan and create test fixtures, configure products for testing, log the measurements for data collection/ graphing, and troubleshoot, repair, and modify circuit board assemblies focusing on the chargers and live batteries. You will assist in the maintenance of lab equipment and operating procedures, as well as being a resource for entry-level technicians.

  
  

**You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:**

* Test chargers and batteries in methods that are consistent with best practices for lithium-ion charging systems.

* Performing hands on mechanical testing of batteries and tools.

* Collect data through various equipment and software programs.

* Perform tests per work instructions and other procedures.

* Prepare reports of test results and make recommendations as needed.

* Provide updates to Engineers on projects.

* Create and edit documents using the Microsoft software suite.

Manage lab space

* - tools/parts/work surfaces/consumable materials.

* Move between lab spaces to execute and monitor testing.
  

  

**What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:**

* Associate's degree in engineering technology or High School diploma accompanied by 4+ years of experience.

* 3+ years of experience with mechanical/electrical principles, test equipment, product life/performance test procedures and methods.

* Knowledge of test concepts in the design and development of products and components.

* Capability to lift and manipulate 50lbs.

* Ability to travel between lab locations on foot or by vehicle if needed.

* Interest and ability to use power tools to simulate consumer usage.

* Ability to reach out to cross functional groups for reference or troubleshooting.

* Strong mechanical mindset and aptitude. Some experience with using hand and shop tools is expected

* Effectively manages multiple tasks to achieve desired outcomes and deliver to deadlines.
  

  

**Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:**

* Experience with Lithium-Ion battery charging system methods and test environments.

* Experience in using data acquisition equipment such as Agilent data buckets.

* Experience in viewing schematics and PCB layout files in an environment such as Altium.

* Operate various lab equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, and e-loads.

* Ability to reach out to cross functional groups for reference or troubleshooting.
  

  

**We provide these great perks and benefits:**

* Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
* Generous 401(k) savings plan.
* Education assistance.
* On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.
* And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.
  

  

**Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.**

Milwaukee Tool, founded in 1924, is a global leader in delivering innovative solutions to the professional construction trades that increase productivity and safety. Milwaukee® is known for their world-leading M12™, M18™, and MX FUEL™ cordless systems, the ground-breaking performance of their cordless innovations, safety solutions, battery-powered outdoor power equipment, jobsite lighting and clean-up, time-saving accessories, and innovative hand tool and PACKOUT™ Modular Storage Products. The company is dedicated to delivering a steady stream of advanced, trade-specific solutions.
  
  
Milwaukee Tool is a Brookfield, Wisconsin-based subsidiary of Techtronic Industries Co. Ltd. (TTI) (HKEx stock code: 669, ADR symbol: TTNDY). For more information on the full line of Milwaukee® products, please call 1-800-SAWDUST or visit Milwaukee Tool.

**About Pierce, an Oshkosh company**

**At Pierce Manufacturing, we build trucks that protect people and communities around the world. To our team, there is no room for anything less than providing the absolute best. Since 1913, building truck bodies on Model T Ford chassis in an old converted church has evolved to creating highly customized, carefully designed and engineering pumpers, aerials, tankers and rescue units that have no equal. Today, you'll find more than** **30,000 Pierce apparatuses** **on the road that are making a difference in people's lives, every day. To us, every step in the process of building our trucks is personal. From innovation and expertise, to the customization and service. Our trucks are designed to perform under the toughest conditions.**

Ready to shape the future of Connected Vehicle IoT solutions for mission critical equipment that help our everyday heroes? If you are passionate about building a better world through innovative technology, thrive on technical challenges, and are excited to build next generation connected vehicle embedded solution, we invite you to join us as an Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer. As a technical leader and hands-on engineer, you will design and develop embedded software for connected Fire, Refuse Collection, and Concrete Mixer vehicles.

This is a fully onsite role in Greenville, WI. As the Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer you must be able and willing to perform hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and validation on large vocational vehicles. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available for this position.

**YOUR IMPACT**

* Design and Develop - Design & develop embedded software for connected vehicle solutions including telematics, edge computing, remote diagnostics, over-the-air capabilities, vehicle network integration, and video recording/streaming capabilities.
* Technical Leadership - Serve as technical leader, balancing hands-on development with providing technical direction to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Engineering Excellence - Establish architecture standards and best practices for high-quality, production-grade software while driving technical rigor through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Execution Excellence & Delivery - Drive team accountability, Agile execution, and delivery predictability by improving backlog readiness, removing technical roadblocks, and helping the team consistently meet sprint and release commitments.
* Vehicle Validation – Hands on validation on trucks. This role requires working inside trucks to ensure software performs reliably in real world operating conditions.
* Cross functional Collaboration - Collaborate with embedded, cloud, and front-end engineers and product owner, resolve cross functional challenges and ensure successful end to end solution delivery.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience developing embedded software using C and C++. Standout: Rust.
* Experience developing and testing embedded software on Embedded Linux platforms
* Experience with networking concepts and protocols including TCP/IP and UDP
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and embedded software development best practices.
* Strong technical leadership and collaboration skills, with experience leading technical projects while remaining hands-on in software development.
* Experience developing connected mobile asset (e.g., vehicle or mobile equipment) or telematics platforms, including cloud-connected architectures, over-the-air (OTA) updates, cellular-connected devices, and remote fleet management solutions.
* Ability and willingness to perform hands on testing on vehicles, including working inside vehicle cabs and conducting testing in manufacturing and field environments. Occasional travel to customer sites may be required.

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with automotive or heavy-duty vehicle networks, including CAN, J1939, and related protocols.
* Experience developing portable software solutions across multiple embedded hardware platforms, including cross-compilation, platform abstraction, and migration of applications to new processor architectures or operating system environments.
* Experience porting embedded applications to new hardware platforms, including board bring-up, BSP integration, hardware/software debugging, and platform validation.
* Experience with multimedia frameworks (e.g., FFmpeg, GStreamer) and video recording, streaming, and media processing technologies, including RTP, RTSP, WebRTC, or similar protocols.
* Strong sense of initiative, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and solve complex technical problems.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Design Studies
jobs.description:
Madison, Wisconsin, United States | Full-time

Apply by: No close date

  

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

Our team helps customers with project conceptual development, support during design, equipment selection and assistance with operating issues after COD. We assist with apparatus ratings and specifications development for transformers, circuit breakers, switches, cables, series capacitors, dynamic var devices, etc.

**Minimum** **Requirements:** MSEE (PhD is desirable)15+ year performing most of the studies listed above.Expert user of PSCAD. (knowledge of ATP and EMTP-RV a plus); expert user of positive sequence/phasor domain tools; a professional engineers license is preferred but not required. **Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

***Job Title: Senior Specialist, Electrical Engineer, Propulsion Control Systems***

***Job Code: 45697***

***Job Location: Canoga Park, CA or Hunstville, AL***

***Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off***

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and verification of propulsion control systems for advanced defense aerospace platforms. This role focuses on electrical and electronic hardware used in engine control, actuation, sensing, power distribution, and embedded control interfaces for mission-critical propulsion applications. The engineer will work across the full product lifecycle in a highly regulated environment where safety, reliability, and performance are essential.

**Essential Functions:**

* Design and develop electrical architecture, circuit designs, and interface definitions for propulsion control systems and subsystems.
* Support development of engine control electronics, sensor/actuator interfaces, power conditioning, wiring, and signal integrity solutions.
* Create and review schematics, requirements, interface control documents, test procedures, and design analyses.
* Perform component selection, derating, tolerance analysis, and failure analysis for aerospace and defense applications.
* Support hardware integration, troubleshooting, verification, validation, and qualification testing in lab and system environments.
* Collaborate with systems, software, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and test engineering teams to deliver integrated propulsion control solutions.
* Ensure designs comply with customer requirements, military standards, airworthiness expectations, and internal engineering processes.
* Participate in design reviews, root cause investigations, risk reduction activities, and corrective action efforts.
* Contribute technical input to program planning, cost/schedule estimates, and engineering trade studies.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership within assigned work scope.
* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.
* Travel: 25%.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior electrical engineering experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior electrical engineering experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior electrical engineering experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

  

* Experience with propulsion control components such as sensors, actuators, control electronics, motor drives, or power systems.
* Ability to interpret system requirements and translate them into electrical design solutions.
* 4+ years of experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, DMMs, signal generators, and data acquisition tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Experience with engine control systems, thrust vector control, electro-mechanical actuation, ignition systems, sensors or related propulsion subsystems.
* Knowledge of DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, IPC, or other aerospace/defense electrical standards.
* Experience with FPGA/embedded hardware interfaces, control system integration, or environmental qualification testing.
* Familiarity with requirements management and verification tools such as DOORS, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar engineering toolsets.
* Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related field.

*In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role California, is $106,500 - $197,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.*

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
**Build a Career Protecting What Matters**
  
Are you a blossoming engineer with a passion for embedded systems and a drive to solve complex technical challenges? Join the **Market Expansion Software Team** at BAE Systems and help us protect those who protect us.
  
We are developing critical seeker, guidance, and control technologies for precision munitions within our Precision Strike & Sensing Solutions (PGSS) business. This is a unique opportunity for an early career engineer to get hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technology and make a tangible contribution to national security from day one.
  
**The Opportunity**
  
As a Software Engineer II, you won't just be writing code—you'll be learning the art of embedded systems engineering. You will be integrated into a high-visibility program, working alongside seasoned Principal Engineers and Subject Matter Experts. You will become a key contributor on a fast-paced program delivering demonstratable value at strategic test events.
  
**What You’ll Do**

* **Develop & Code:** Write high-quality, reliable code in C/C++ for complex embedded systems
* **Work with Cutting-Edge Hardware:** Gain experience with embedded processors, GPUs and military-grade sensors and electronics
* **Explore Operating Systems:** Work across a variety of environments, ranging from bare metal to Embedded Linux
* **Collaborate:** Partner with Systems, Hardware, and Test engineers to help translate requirements into efficient software solutions demonstrated on range
* **Learn & Grow:** Participate in design reviews and collaborate on engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* Strong foundational knowledge of **C/C++**, including an understanding of data structures, algorithms, and memory management
* Exposure to embedded systems development through coursework, internships, or personal projects
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with development boards (ex, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone Black, Arduino Uno, STM32)
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Coursework in signal processing, guidance, or control systems
* Practiced in the training and use of AI models beyond LLMs
* Exposure to Agile workflows, CI/CD tools, or static code analysis
* Experience with Python
* Confident and responsible use of generative AI tools used in the development of software
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $72150 - $122655
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  
  
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

**Brief Summary**:

Senior Electrical Systems Engineers work closely with optical, mechanical, software, and test engineers to develop, verify, and validate requirements for cutting-edge complex optical and electro-optical systems. In the early phases of a project or program, they work to understand the customer's needs, internal capabilities, and participate in technology readiness reviews to identify capability gaps and developmental risks. They specifically lead the analysis in relation to electrical and electronics subsystems including integration of analyses from other disciplines. Senior Electrical Systems Engineers are responsible for understanding all system interfaces and leading the development of rigorous electrical integration and test plans to ensure each system and subsystem requirement is appropriately addressed. Subsequently, they execute on those plans by utilizing their extensive hands-on assembly, integration, and testing (AI&T) skillsets for electrical components and overseeing other disciplines’ AI&T efforts.

A Senior Electrical Systems Engineer leads a wide variety of technical activities during the product realization process for systems involving a high level of complexity, with an emphasis on electro-optic assemblies. Additionally, a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer will be expected to design, build and test custom electronics for testing and/or manufacturing equipment. With an electro-optical systems focus, they are primarily tasked with hands-on integration and testing of electronic components, PCBs, and interconnects. They are charged with leading the planning and execution of activities for projects that may involve precision cleanroom assembly, specialized equipment/fixturing, and custom test bed development. They help in assessing existing Edmund Optics equipment and processes to ensure requirements for a variety of products can be effectively verified. Additionally, a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer plays an important role in training and mentoring more junior engineers.

Responsibilities:

**Primary Responsibilities:**

Electrical:

* Review customer provided and supplier provided electrical and electronic designs, schematics, PCB layouts, and support documentation for suitability against system requirements.
* Evaluate electrical and electronic designs for functionality, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and testability; identify risks and recommend improvements.
* Develop or oversee PCB layouts, fabrication, and assembly for custom electronic hardware.
* Design, build, and test custom electronics and interconnect subsystems and test software for development, integration, verification, and manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and modify basic microcontroller firmware, including Arduino-like applications, for sensor acquisition, device communication, and equipment control.
* Document and support electrical design review findings and coordinate resolution of technical issues with the responsible engineers.
* Develop training materials and procedures for the use and maintenance of custom electronics and test equipment.
* Improve electrical design review, requirements management, integration, and verification processes using lessons learned from project execution.

Systems:

* Translate customer needs and/or technical data package and intended operating conditions into measurable system and subsystem requirements.
* Lead cross-disciplinary development, allocation, and review of system requirements, with specific responsibility for electrical requirements.
* Reviewing, defining and documenting electrical interfaces and coordinating their compatibility with mechanical, optical, and software interfaces.
* Maintain traceability between customer needs, system requirements, subsystem requirements, and verification results.
* Lead electrical architecture development and contribute to system architecture decisions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines.
* Coordinate resolution of technical conflicts between disciplines to maintain overall system performance and compatibility.
* Assess assembly and testing capabilities and recommend equipment and tool acquisitions.
* Understand system interfaces and the impact of each subsystem on top-level system requirements.

AI&T:

* Develop electrical integration plans that define interface checks, integration sequence, prerequisites, and criteria for proceeding to the next project phase.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary integration activities, ensuring that subsystem dependencies and interface requirements are addressed.
* Perform hands-on electrical assembly, initial start-up, integration, and troubleshooting of components, PCBs, wiring, and interconnects.
* Define verification methods and acceptance criteria for electrical and system requirements in collaboration with the engineering team.

General:

* Prepare and review technical documentation, including requirements, interface definitions, design analyses, test plans, drawings and engineering reports.
* Mentor engineers and technicians in electrical troubleshooting, design review processes, systems thinking, and disciplined test practices.
* Facilitate the assembly and modification of test equipment to support short-term project-specific and long-term strategic needs.
* Work closely with cross functional engineers to develop and evaluate interfaces between electronics and existing hardware and software.
* Evaluate and ensure the safety, performance, and reliability of new product designs involving laser diodes, photodiodes, image sensors, and other electronics.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills & Abilities****:**

* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, circuit analysis, interconnect and cabling, and practical electrical design and construction principles.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, laboratory power supplies, function generators, and related electrical test equipment.

Your work connects our most advanced technologies with the customers who depend on them, enabling the next generation of semiconductor innovation.
