* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Software development experience in C++, C#, or Python.
* Ability to read code and work effectively in a debugger or IDE.

**What Sets You Apart**

Experience with any of the following:

* Machine control software, including semiconductor equipment.
* Windows and real-time operating systems.
* Multi-threaded or real-time applications.
* Graphical user interfaces.
* Device drivers or interrupt-driven software.
* Data communications, networking, or EtherCAT.

**Apply today to be part of what’s next.**

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

new_jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

Department of Defense TS/SCI security clearance is preferred at time of hire. Candidates must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance within a reasonable amount of time from date of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:**

As a Systems Engineering Integration & Test Engineer - TIDES FPGA, you will be a member of the Payload Integration and Evolution (PIE) team within SEIT’s organization. The PIE team develops and evolves the Payload Verification Platform (PVP), a hardware development environment made up of COTS and custom FPGA boards, development kits, and supporting infrastructure used to emulate spacecraft payload behavior for early integration, risk reduction, and test software development.

In this role, you will help define, architect, and lead FPGA-enabled capabilities for the PVP, from early requirements and microarchitecture through RTL implementation, simulation, timing closure, interface integration, and lab bring-up. Your work will mature reusable test infrastructure that bridges test equipment with units under test, enables real-time functions such as packet timestamping and precision command scheduling, and supports payload programs as they move from early development toward verification and flight readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead FPGA-supported development and integration activities for the Payload Verification Platform (PVP) as part of the Payload Integration and Evolution (PIE) team within SEIT’s TIDES organization
* Architect, design, integrate, and mature COTS and custom FPGA-based development platforms used to emulate spacecraft payload behavior for early integration, risk reduction, and test software development
* Define FPGA and hardware integration approaches that bridge test equipment, payload hardware, and software infrastructure
* Lead RTL development, simulation, interface integration, timing closure support, and lab bring-up for FPGA-enabled test capabilities
* Drive real-time test functions such as payload interface emulation, packet timestamping, precision command scheduling, and protocol translation
* Collaborate with systems, electrical, software, test, and program teams to derive platform requirements and resolve integration issues
* Lead structured debug efforts using lab instrumentation, waveform analysis, software tools, and root-cause investigation
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews, integration planning, technical roadmaps, and platform evolution
* Document architecture, interface definitions, bring-up procedures, release artifacts, and lessons learned

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
* Significant experience with FPGA design, RTL development, hardware integration, and lab bring-up
* Proficiency with SystemVerilog and/or VHDL, simulation, timing constraints, and FPGA vendor toolchains such as Vivado, Lattice Diamond/Radiant, or equivalent
* Experience integrating FPGA interfaces such as Ethernet, SPI, UART, JESD204B/C, high-speed serial links, or custom board-level protocols
* Strong understanding of digital design, clock-domain crossing, reset strategy, synchronous/asynchronous interfaces, and timing closure
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, protocol analyzers, and waveform capture tools
* Experience working across systems, hardware, software, and test teams to define requirements and drive integration closure
* Proficiency with scripting and automation using Python, Tcl, Linux shell, or similar tools
* Experience with Linux environments, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and controlled FPGA artifact release processes
* Familiarity with payload integration, hardware development environments, spacecraft electronics, or verification platforms is strongly preferred

**What Sets You Apart**

* You think at the platform level and understand how FPGA design decisions affect payload integration, test software, lab operations, and program execution
* You can move comfortably between architecture, RTL, simulation, timing, lab debug, and system integration
* You have a track record of taking complex hardware/software integration problems from ambiguity to root cause and closure
* You write clean, maintainable RTL, scripts, documentation, and interface definitions that other engineers can build on
* You are effective in the lab and can isolate whether an issue belongs to the FPGA, board, cable, instrument, software interface, or test configuration
* You mentor others, raise the technical standard of the team, and help shape reusable platform capabilities
* You communicate clearly across disciplines and can translate between systems needs, electrical constraints, FPGA implementation, and test objectives
* You identify opportunities to use automation and AI tools to improve engineering efficiency, debug workflows, and platform maturity

**Our Commitment to You:**

* An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
* Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
* Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
* Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups,

new_jobs.description:
Phoenix, Arizona, United States | Full-time

Apply by: No close date

  

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable.

Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.

Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed.

* Build automated tests, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet.

* Practical experience with peripheral drivers and communication buses such as CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C.
* Comfort reading schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers to isolate problems across electrical and software boundaries.
* The ability to reason about system failures and implement robust state machines, fault detection, safe outputs, and recovery paths.

new_jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate, small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we opened our Detroit manufacturing hub and field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

**The Role and Your Impact:**  
We need a Robotics Software Engineer who writes fast, correct C++ that runs on real hardware. You’ll work on the Archimedes stack alongside our Lead Software Engineer, taking raw sensor data and turning it into tracking, control and autonomy that has to work in real time. Performance and accuracy matter more than anything. Your scope grows as fast as you do; our Lead went from Founding Robotics Engineer to Lead in 12 months.

**What You’ll Own:**

* Production C++ across the stack: sensor ingestion, tracking, control and autonomy
* Working directly with drivers and raw sensor data, not pre-packaged inputs
* Threading, process architecture and performance on the paths you own
* Timing and latency analysis, and making the fixes it points to
* Python tooling for testing, analysis and the range
* Debugging on hardware at weekly field tests

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2+ years writing production C++ that runs on real hardware or real-time systems
* Comfort below the abstraction layer: threading, concurrency, memory, performance profiling
* You implement, not just design. You’ve shipped code you wrote
* Evidence you learn fast: you got effective in a new domain in months, not years

**Where you probably come from:** We’re domain agnostic. Robotics, AV, drones, aerospace, F1 or automotive, maritime, embedded systems, compilers, or low-level C++ game engine and 3D simulation work all fit. A robotics degree isn’t required; the robotics is learnable on the job.

**We want to talk if:** You’ve written C++ where latency or timing actually mattered and you measured it. Bonus if your projects touch motion planning, dynamics, trajectory optimization, or state estimation.

**Not a fit if:** You’re web, backend or full stack; your C++ is light and your real work is in Python; you’ve never had a full-time role; or you design systems but don’t implement them.

**Nice to Haves:**

* ROS2 (a good signal, though we've moved past it)
* Rust or other systems languages
* Sensor integration and calibration
* Real-time Linux

**Education:** BS, MS or PhD in CS, EE, Robotics or equivalent. Track record matters more than degree.

**How You Operate:**

* Extreme bias for action. You'd rather build a prototype tomorrow than model it for a month
* You characterize your own systems before the field does
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a startup environment
* You debug from first principles, not intuition alone
* Clear communicator across mechanical, electrical, optical, and software teams
* Self directed. You identify what needs to happen next and do it without being told

**Why Join Aurelius Systems:**

* Build more in 1 month than most engineers build in 1 year. We field test weekly. Your work goes downrange, not into a filing cabinet.
* Career velocity is real. With no middle management, there are no layers between you and impact.
* Work on a problem that actually matters. Small cheap drones are changing warfare. Our laser systems are the asymmetric answer — infinite magazine, near zero cost per shot, scalable to every base, border, facility, and truck.
* Join the densest defense startup ecosystem in the country. California is where the next generation of defense companies are being built.

**How We Work:**

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9 to 6. When we're sprinting toward a demo or field test, the team ramps up — nights, weekends, whatever it takes to ship. When the sprint lands, we ramp down. We don't manufacture intensity for show. If you've worked at SpaceX, against a mission-critical timeline, or on a racing team, you already know the rhythm.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and equity
* United Health Care medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible 18 days PTO plus 5 sick days
* Travel to field test events and range days
* Covered daily lunches and office snacks and drinks
* E-bike and scooter stipend up to $500
* Direct access to leadership and real ownership over your work

**Export Control Notice:**

This role requires access to export-controlled information or items that require U.S. Person status. As defined by U.S. law, individuals who are any one of the following are considered to be a U.S. Person: (1) U.S. citizens, (2) legal permanent residents (a.k.a. green card holders), and (3) certain protected classes of asylees and refugees, as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

new_jobs.description:
**About Bridge Neurotech**
--------------------------

Bridge Neurotech is building a non-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI-based neural decoding for brain-computer interface applications. We are a seed-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for an Electrical Engineering Lead to own the architecture strategy and delivery of the electronic systems behind Bridge’s custom ultrasound hardware: from system partitioning and component selection through schematic, layout, bring-up, and validated hardware.

Two design challenges sit at the center of this role. The first is high-speed I/O: moving raw acquisition data off the front-end over multi-gigabit-per-second links, with a focus on designing for signal integrity, clocking, and proper layout. The second is power delivery: multi-rail systems operating at watts of power, designed for efficiency and thermal headroom.

You will interface with ASICs at register level, write Python daily for bring-up and test automation, and know enough firmware to collaborate efficiently with our embedded systems team.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end electronics architecture of Bridge’s custom imaging hardware: system partitioning, component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout oversight, bring-up, and design validation.
* Design and deliver boards with multi-gigabit-per-second serial links (e.g., LVDS, JESD204, PCIe/USB 3.x-class SerDes), owning signal integrity, impedance control, clocking, and high-speed layout.
* Architect watts-class power delivery: multi-rail regulation, sequencing, efficiency, thermal design, and noise isolation for sensitive analog acquisition circuitry.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate ultrasound transmit/receive ASICs and analog front-ends: own the electrical interface to custom silicon and drive vendor relationships.
* Co-define the hardware/software boundary with the Embedded Systems Lead: digital interface definition, control plane, and data path. Write firmware where it accelerates bring-up.
* Build Python-based bring-up, characterization, and automated test tooling for every board revision.
* Lead board bring-up, debug, and failure analysis; manage PCB fabrication and assembly vendors and drive design reviews.
* Mentor the R&D Engineer, reviewing their schematics, layouts, and test methodology.
* Lay the documentation and design-control groundwork for eventual development in a regulated environment.

**Who you are**
---------------

**Required**

* Degree in electrical engineering or related field, with 6+ years of hands-on board-level design experience and multiple custom boards taken through production or production-equivalent builds.

Poseidon Aerospace is reimagining how the world moves goods. We build and operate full-size autonomous cargo aircraft - capable of carrying two tons of payload over a thousand nautical miles. From remote communities to contested logistics operations, our platforms unlock a new cost curve for air freight, making it faster, cheaper, and accessible anywhere it's needed. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with locations in Washington DC, Oregon, and Maine; we're building something consequential.

------------------

Flight software is the code that runs on the flight computers of our autonomous cargo aircraft. As a Senior Flight Software Engineer you will own major parts of that software, from architecture through flight test. You will decide how the software is structured, how it handles failures, and how it is tested, and you will write a large share of the code yourself. You will also set the technical bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the architecture of major flight software subsystems, including timing, partitioning, and redundancy
* Design and implement deterministic, real-time embedded flight software in C++
* Design fault detection and response for the aircraft, including redundancy management, degraded modes, and lost-link behavior
* Define software requirements and interfaces with avionics, GNC, and flight test, and trace them to tests
* Implement the GNC team’s algorithms in flight code and verify them against simulation
* Set the test strategy across unit tests, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop
* Build telemetry, logging, and command paths between the aircraft and the ground station
* Lead software integration on the aircraft and support ground testing and flight test, including travel to our flight test site
* Set coding standards and review practices, and lead design reviews
* Mentor other flight software engineers

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* B.S. in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of professional C or C++ development on embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems
* Owned a flight software subsystem or equivalent from architecture through fielded operation
* Took software through hardware integration and test on a real vehicle (aircraft, spacecraft, or automotive)
* Designed fault detection and response for a system where failure had safety consequences
* Led design reviews and set technical direction for other engineers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Flight software experience on crewed or uncrewed aircraft, or on spacecraft
* RTOS or bare-metal development, with a deep understanding of scheduling, timing, and memory

**Why this role**

Flight software touches every system on the aircraft: avionics, propulsion, flight controls, and the ground station. You will make the decisions that shape how those systems work together, at a stage where the architecture is still yours to set. You will work directly with flight hardware and watch your code fly an aircraft that carries two tons.

* Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity

**Company:**

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Modem Software Engineering

**General Summary:**

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G — ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age — and this is where you come in.

  
  

The MMODE team develops protocol software that enables intelligent system selection and mobility across terrestrial and satellite wireless networks. MMODE software determines how devices discover, select, acquire, and transition between available connectivity options while balancing user experience, network performance, power efficiency, and operator requirements. Engineers work on technologies including 5G NR, LTE, NTN, Multi-SIM, emergency services, and next-generation connectivity solutions, collaborating closely with systems, modem firmware, and test teams to deliver innovative wireless features.

  
  

As a Modem Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize real-time embedded software for Qualcomm's modem subsystem (MPSS). You will work close to the metal — writing performant, resource-constrained C/C++ that runs on DSP and Arm cores across cellular protocol layers, device drivers, and RTOS-level components.

  
  

Beyond traditional embedded development, this role is explicitly **AI-native** . You are expected to leverage, build, and improve AI-assisted development workflows — using code-generation agents, LLM-based code review, automated test synthesis, log/crash triage assistants, and retrieval-augmented tooling over our codebase — to dramatically accelerate delivery, quality, and debugging in a highly complex firmware environment.

  
  

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and optimize **real-time embedded modem software** across protocol layers, drivers, and platform services, meeting strict latency, memory, and power constraints.
* Apply rigorous **data-structure and algorithm** design to build efficient, scalable firmware components.
* Own end-to-end feature delivery: requirements, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, on-target bring-up, and maintenance.
* **Pioneer AI-native development practices** within the team — integrate AI coding agents into daily workflows, establish agent rules and prompt patterns, and measurably reduce development and debug cycle time.
* Build and maintain **AI-assisted tooling** for code review, static analysis, test synthesis, and automated crash/log triage over the modem codebase.
* Debug and root-cause complex, multi-layer issues on target hardware, increasingly leveraging AI-assisted analysis of logs, traces, and RAM dumps.

new_jobs.title: Flight Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Flight Systems Engineering and Test**

SiFly Aviation · Santa Clara, CA · Onsite · Full-time

At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical-takeoff, long-endurance drones that deliver helicopter-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast.

**The role**

We fly a lot – and are building methodical ways of turning data from flights into evolved control system decisions. You’ll design test flight campaigns for the questions we need to answer and develop instrumentation that produces trustworthy data. You’ll drive and develop dashboards that tell us whether weight, performance, and reliability are moving the right way.

You'll also be a large part of how we tune and validate changes to PX4 — configuration and code — and how the resulting data gets back to the engineers who need it.

**What you'll do**

* Plan and execute test campaigns end to end — objectives, success criteria, test cards, instrumentation, and safety and site coordination.
* Choose the right validation modality for each question: simulation, log replay, hardware-in-the-loop, ground test, or flight. Spend flight time on the highest-value learning.
* Tune and test changes to PX4 — parameters, control and estimation tuning, and configuration — and validate them in the air.
* Analyze flight logs and telemetry to diagnose issues across firmware, hardware, and companion computers.
* Build and maintain test infrastructure: benches, HIL setups, instrumentation, and the data pipelines and dashboards behind them.
* Own the progression from bench test, through integrated ground runs, to flight — and the anomaly reports and configuration records that make a campaign reconstructable.
* Generate the flight test evidence used in SiFly’s FAA submissions.
* Find, build, and share AI-assisted approaches to this work — log analysis, test data reduction, reporting — and bring the team along with what works.

**What we're looking for**

* Hands-on flight test or systems test on real aircraft, manned or unmanned. You build test setups, not just operate them.
* You've closed the loop from controls systems or flight data back into autopilot parameters or code, repeatedly, on real equipment.
* Estimation and control fundamentals: coordinate frames, Kalman filtering and sensor fusion, PID analysis.
* Data analysis and scripting — Python or equivalent — for reducing test data into something people act on.
* Comfortable at the aircraft: instrumentation, harnessing, and debugging on the flight line.
* Ability to obtain and use FAA Part 107 certification if not already certified.
* First-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies.
* This is a hands-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development.
* You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors.

**Nice to have**

* Existing FAA Part 107 certification and real drone piloting or field-testing experience.
* Flight test instrumentation design — sensors, DAQ, wiring and installation for test.
* ROS 2, MAVSDK, Linux companion computers; safety risk management process for flight testing.

**Details**

* Onsite in Santa Clara, CA.
* Small team, high ownership, and real hardware in the building.

**About Neuralink:**

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

**Team Description:**

Neuralink's Information Technology team owns the corporate environment that every engineer, scientist, and clinician depends on to do their work. Within IT, the Compute function is responsible for the physical and server infrastructure that powers neural recording training, data processing, and engineering workloads: the data center floor itself, the GPU and HPC clusters that run on it, and the storage, provisioning, and monitoring that keep those systems healthy. We build this infrastructure from the ground up, manage it as code, and treat uptime for research workloads as production.

**Job Description and Responsibilities:**

Neuralink is looking for a hands-on Systems Engineer with deep expertise in data center design, build, and operations. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our compute and storage infrastructure, from site buildout and hardware procurement through deployment, automation, and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate brings equal comfort on the data center floor and at the keyboard, thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, and has a passion for building reliable, scalable systems from the ground up. The job responsibilities will include:

* Design, build, and operate data center environments including power infrastructure (PDUs, UPS, generators), cooling systems (CRAC/CRAH, liquid cooling), and scalable racking; drive capacity planning for power, cooling, and floor space
* Own the full server and storage lifecycle: hardware selection and procurement, rack and cable, commissioning with BIOS/firmware tuning and integration testing, maintenance, and decommission
* Administer and manage HPC and GPU clusters and high-performance storage systems
* Automate server provisioning using PXE/HTTP boot, scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python), and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Puppet
* Administer Linux and Windows server environments including OS deployment, patching, hardening, and performance tuning
* Operate infrastructure monitoring and alerting; drive capacity planning for compute and storage from the data
* Plan and coordinate maintenance windows, upgrades, and expansions; maintain 24/7 on-call readiness for compute and storage incidents
* Ensure all systems comply with HIPAA, PII handling requirements, and applicable cybersecurity standards (ISO, NIST)
* Author and maintain systems design documents, rack and power diagrams, runbooks, SOPs, hardware inventory, and DCIM records

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience building and supporting HPC or high-density compute environments: GPU clusters, high-performance storage
* Hands-on experience with data center power, cooling, and racking design and operations
* Strong Linux server administration experience; working knowledge of Windows Server
* Experience automating bare-metal provisioning (PXE/HTTP boot) and configuration management with Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet
* Familiarity with DCIM tools and infrastructure monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and NTP as they apply to server deployment and troubleshooting

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with cluster resource managers (Slurm, LSF, PBS)
* Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/Proxmox) and storage ecosystems (NAS/SAN, NFS/iSCSI)

new_jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Bridge Neurotech**
--------------------------

Bridge Neurotech is building a non-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI-based neural decoding for brain-computer interface applications. We are a seed-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to turn ideas into physical parts, and to turn the making of those parts into a repeatable process. Almost nothing we build can be bought, so we need to build our own as one-off or low-volume production. You will own that work: design it, build it, test it, scale it.

This is a hands-on lab role with significant breadth: CAD in the morning, soldering in the afternoon, and Python scripting in between. We expect you to use AI coding tools to develop automations and bespoke tools to improve efficiency.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Design and iterate mechanical part design in CAD, for example probe housings, mounts, fixtures, enclosures, and lab hardware.
* Own our 3D printing: run and maintain the printers, dial in materials and profiles, manage the queue, and keep turnaround measured in hours.
* Build the workflow and automation around 3D printing and CNC, for example scripted slicing and job submission, print farm monitoring, CAM setup, revision control, and part tracking.
* Develop processes for low-volume part production, for example mold design and fabrication, casting, potting, bonding, finishing, and the jigs and fixtures those processes need.
* Do the work that makes hardware real: fine-pitch and through-hole soldering, cable and harness assembly, routing, and careful assembly of delicate parts.
* Build and maintain test fixtures and benchtop setups, and keep lab equipment calibrated, organized, and working.
* Write Python to glue the shop together: automation, instrument control, data logging, and part and inventory tracking.
* Support the team’s everyday hardware needs, for example specifying and ordering equipment, setting up workstations and lab machines, and keeping the shop stocked.
* Work directly with our imaging scientists and research team to understand how each part will actually be used.

**Who you are**
---------------

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Working proficiency in CAD: parametric modeling, assemblies, drawings, and design for manufacturing.
* Hands-on 3D printing experience, for example tuning, troubleshooting, and repair, plus the judgment to know when a part should be printed, machined, or molded.
* Strong technician skills: comfortable soldering both boards and wire, building clean harnesses, and assembling precision hardware without breaking it.
* Demonstrated experience with Python. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to write a real script, for example file handling, an API call, a serial interface, some data wrangling, without it being a project.
* Fluent with AI coding tools and comfortable vibe coding your way to working tooling.
* A bias toward building, testing, and improving over designing to completion first.
* Self-directed and self-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step-by-step guide.

**Nice to have**

* PCB layout experience, particularly in Altium.
* CNC machining experience, for example CAM programming, fixturing, workholding.
* IT and lab infrastructure work, for example specifying and ordering computers, installing software, and managing network and lab equipment.
* Personal projects, a shop of your own, robotics or FSAE, or other evidence that you build things unprompted.
* Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Real ownership of the hardware this company runs on, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales.
* A shop you get to build. We buy the equipment and tooling; you decide what we need and how it runs.
* Direct collaboration with our imaging scientists and research team, and with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top-tier academic institutions.
* Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind.
* Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k).

Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

**Description of work effort:**

Join NASA Ames writing software to help explore the moon! Help us meet the emerging needs of Artemis, Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) and future Moon-to-Mars missions. Looking for a software engineer to assist with development of two coordinated work efforts:

These tools provide a reusable, science-centric collaboration platform that enables distributed science teams to collectively visualize, analyze, and interpret mission data in support of time-critical decision making. They will prototype capability for uncertainty-aware fusion of orbital and surface terrain data for real-time operational decision support.

M2M CSDS and WITME both build on NASA Ames - developed collaborative data systems and science operations architectures matured through the Exploration Ground Data Systems (xGDS) research project and VIPER mission science operations.

M2M CSDS development will require the applicant to work closely with an active CLPS science team to populate the proof-of-concept M2M CSDS with mission relevant data. Software development will include an interactive, shared planning/replanning and execution monitoring capability that builds on design concepts developed for the Ames-led xGDS in a mature mission-proven environment. The work effort will include the integration of FedRAMP and NASA approved AI tools (e.g. Google Gemini) to provide summarization and search capabilities on the data sets and annotations deployed in M2M CSDS. These capabilities are anticipated to provide substantial benefits for supporting real-time science and operations (e.g. rapid initial generation of shift handover highlights that can be further augmented and edited by science team members).

WITME involves the development and application of statistically principled fusion methods to weight orbital and surface data by their uncertainties, and build unified 3D models with quantitative confidence estimates derived from these data. Specifically, the applicant will help develop effective user interfaces and displays to communicate confidence in terrain model data at different locations. This will enable mission teams to rapidly assimilate new terrain data, improving traverse planning and decision-making through a collaborative web-based interface.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

At SpaceXSI, we design, build, and operate the largest AI supercomputers in the world, from the ground up. As a member of the Platform Core team, you will be responsible for the lowest layers of the software stack on the devices setting the pace for how fast we can push the frontier of AI. Our team's software interfaces directly with the core hardware of the supercomputer and its network fabric. Our mission is to expose the full capability of that hardware — limited only by physics — to the rest of the stack, all while retaining the smallest, most robust footprint possible.  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Build and maintain the lean, high-reliability Linux-based operating system that underpins our supercomputer network fabric.
* Write (or rewrite) high-performance device drivers to extract the maximum physical capability from our network and compute hardware.
* Manage deployment, operation, and debugging of our platform in production, including:
* + Rigorous resolution and root-causing of anomalies to ensure the system is constantly improving in reliability.
  + Developing and constantly improving our tools for observability and configuration management.
* Collaborate with our hardware teams and external partners to design the next generation of supercomputer hardware – and then bring up our OS and software stack on it.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Hands-on systems programming experience in C or C++.
* Strong operating systems fundamentals (scheduling, memory management, I/O) — you must be able to articulate in extreme detail how a computer works, from the hardware all the way up to high-level applications.
* Understanding of computer networking, both in the host (OS stack) as well as common network devices like switches and routers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel and its networking stack — transferable experience with another production-grade kernel is okay, too!
* Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more).
* Experience bringing up new hardware from scratch — you have flashed bare-metal software on a microcontroller with JTAG, or bootstrapped a Linux kernel and rootfs on new hardware.
* Demonstrated track record of developing and optimizing device/peripheral drivers — ideally for high-speed interfaces, or with advanced considerations like DMA and cache coherency.
* Understanding of major peripheral hardware interface standards (Ethernet, PCIe, I2C, SPI, etc.) — you can critically review a schematic, and debug these interfaces if needed.
* Experience with product security, OS/system hardening, and secure boot schemes.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$180,000 - $440,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

new_jobs.description:

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

**Why Roblox & Agent Infra**
----------------------------

The Agent Infra team builds the infrastructure that runs autonomous AI agents at Roblox for millions of creators building experiences on our platform, and for thousands of Roblox engineers shipping production code every day.

Agent workloads break the assumptions most infrastructure is built on. They run for hours instead of milliseconds, they’re non-deterministic, they execute code nobody wrote, and they need real credentials against real systems to be useful at all. Making that safe, durable, and cost-effective at Roblox’s scale is the hard problem our team is solving.

As an early member of the Agent Infra team, you’ll work alongside an experienced engineering team on systems that are already in front of real users, at scale, in a field that didn’t exist two years ago.

**You Are**
-----------

* **Demonstrated experience:** 8+ years building and operating backend, distributed, or infrastructure systems in production, including systems you designed that held up at scale for years.
* **Deep expertise** in at least one of our core domains: workflow orchestration, scalable backend infrastructure, agentic runtimes, or secure sandboxing and access.
* **Hands-on:** You spend most of your time building, and you write production code in Go, Python, Rust, or similar.
* **Agent-native:** Agents drive your daily work. You’ve experimented with swarms, loops, and orchestration, you have strong opinions on harness and model choice, and you’re constantly evolving your agentic workflow.
* **Experienced with agents in production:** You’ve run agents against real systems, seen how they fail, and know what the infrastructure underneath should do about it.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.

**You Will**
------------

* **Set the technical direction:** Own the design and implementation of Roblox’s core agent infrastructure, and scale it to serve every internal and external customer.
* **Drive reliability and security:** Keep long-running agents alive through deploys, restarts, and outages. Run untrusted code in sandboxes that keep credentials out of the agent’s reach and control what it can reach on the network. Define the SLOs and observability that hold the platform to account.
* **Raise the bar:** Keep learning and experimenting with agentic workflows, and bring what works to the team and the wider Foundation AI org.
* **Align across the org:** Partner with Security, Engineering Efficiency, and Infrastructure so the agent platform and the systems it depends on are built in the same direction.
* **Multiply the team:** Mentor senior engineers, lead design reviews, and push how far agents can build the agent platform itself.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Security experience with systems that run untrusted code: sandbox and container isolation (gVisor, Firecracker, microVMs), Kubernetes hardening, network segmentation and egress control.
* Experience working with Temporal, AWS, and self-hosted models.
* Experience building and deploying production systems on Kubernetes, using GitOps and Argo CD.
* Contributions to open source or experience building your own product with real user traction.

**Job Summary:** Our team is developing next-generation spacecraft that push the boundaries of performance and capability in orbit. We are seeking a highly skilled platform software engineer to own the Board Support Package (BSP) and fabric bring-up for our accelerator compute payloads. This includes everything from the bootloader and Linux kernel to driver initialization and fabric management. These solutions draft contracts, requirements, engineering specifications, and code that previously took teams months to produce. As Principal Engineer, you will define and drive the multi-year, architecture for this platform: unifying fragmented workflows into scalable, flexible, and compliant FinTech solutions, and setting the technical direction for how Gen AI is applied safely and accurately across financial systems. This is a strategic investment adopted not just by the Devices & Services organization, but also teams across Digital, Ads and Consumer groups. You will shape the strategy that accelerates timelines from months to days, enabling every D&S business to launch and monetize faster.  
  
Another core dependency for accelerating Devices product development lifecycle from months to days requires providing agentic and builder access to Amazon's diverse portfolio of Devices throughout the build process. We provide 16 businesses across Devices, Ads, and Digital teams elastic device capacity and operate as the singular entry point for every device type and setup at Amazon. Amazon Device Farm services provide the device signal that fuels the fast feedback loops autonomous agentic systems and builders need for product development - providing agents and builders unified, elastic device capacity, configured on demand, with the functionality, reliability, and scale teams require to ship products to customers faster and to higher quality.
  
  
As a core leader in the Devices Global Retail Tech org, you'll work to simplify and accelerate Devices and Services product launches across every Product Line (FireTV, Kindle, Alexa, echo, eero, Leo, and more) as well as key partners in Digital, Ads and Consumer teams by driving the architecture and agentic solutions that remove existing constraints spanning diverse problem domains.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:  
  

* Serve as a technical leader on our most demanding, cross-functional projects, owning the consolidated, Gen AI–powered system architecture that solves key fintech problems across all of D&S and Set the technical vision and direction for the org's fintech space

  

* Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions — designing for reuse across 12+ product lines and multiple geographies rather than one-off integrations.

* Understand the evolving needs of the D&S business and partner deeply with stakeholders across Business Development, Finance, Product, Tech, Accounting, and Tax to translate those needs into durable technical strategy.

  

* Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. You are a technical thought leader, builder, and operator.

  

* Balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices, sequencing a pragmatic roadmap that delivers incremental value while converging on the target-state consolidated system.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

As part of a small team, you will work on New Glenn at the system level for the New Glenn Program. We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

  

As part of the New Glenn SEIT system safety, reliability and risk team, you will work to develop processes and products for the design and evaluation of the New Glenn orbital launch vehicle system and facilities. You must have a passion for mission assurance, a commitment to the fundamentals of system safety/reliability, and a strong capacity to work collaboratively on complex and interesting new problems. You will be part of the SEIT system engineering team and will work across the New Glenn subsystems to support integrated solutions. You will utilize system engineering practices across disciplines predicated to a high degree on your technical skills, ensure consistent system engineering implementations across the New Glenn elements and subsystems, and serve in a system integration capacity working with multi-discipline teams to arrive at technical system solutions. Additionally, this role requires understanding and supporting requirements analysis and traceability, functional analysis, systems analysis, safety analysis, technical performance monitoring, developing strategies and approaches for specialty engineering (operability, reliability, maintainability, supportability) and system product life cycle processes.

  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Assess reliability for the New Glenn system using statistical methods and physics-of-failure modeling including 217+ and NSWC-11
* Use flight data to determine vehicle reliability, availability, and maintainability practices
* Create, evaluate, and perform reviews of system safety and reliability analyses including Hazard Assessments, FMECAs/HAZOPs, Fault Trees, Common Cause Assessments, Reliability Predictions, Reliability Block Diagrams, Human Error Assessments, and Hazard Sheets
* Evaluate safety and reliability products and requirements for compliance with our system safety/reliability processes and products against internal and external standards including Range Safety, NASA, FAA, MIL-STD-882, ARP-4761, and SMC-S-013
* Implement and maintain system safety processes and identify continuous improvement opportunities
* Train and mentor engineers on identifying and analyzing system safety and reliability risks
* Work with systems engineering and subsystem cognizant engineers to identify and verify compliance with system safety and reliability requirements
* Assist in generating metrics and report on program system safety/reliability statuses
* Assess and mitigate program risks

Minimum Qualifications

* Minimum of a B.S. degree in engineering or related field
* 8+ years of professional experience within integrated systems
* Experience with system engineering principles
* Experience in at least one of the areas of analysis, design, or integrated testing
* Engineering experience in at least one of the following areas: fluids, thermal, propulsion, avionics, electrical hardware, telemetry/communications, structural, ground operations or flight/ground autonomy
* Possess strategic and proactive thinking as well as the ability to communicate effectively while working within set timelines
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

* 3+ years Reliability Experience
* Familiarity with HALT/HASS testing

new_jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer**

**Position Summary**

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and support of electrical systems and components used in power distribution and industrial equipment applications. This role will lead electrical design activities, component selection and sizing, procurement support, compliance reviews, electrical testing, and documentation development. The engineer will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Development, and Certification teams to ensure products meet performance, safety, reliability, and regulatory requirements.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Electrical Design & Development**

* Design and develop electrical systems, power distribution equipment, control systems, and related components.
* Create and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, and control drawings.
* Design and develop wiring harnesses, cable assemblies, and interconnect systems.
* Perform electrical load calculations, conductor sizing, component sizing, and system analysis.
* Develop and evaluate prototypes and support new product development activities.
* Support product improvements, cost reduction initiatives, and engineering change activities.

**Component Selection & Procurement**

* Select and specify electrical components including:
  + Circuit breakers
  + Fuses
  + Contactors
  + Relays
  + Terminal blocks
  + Power supplies
  + Sensors
  + HMI devices
  + Wiring and cable assemblies
* Generate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and procurement specifications.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain and vendors to identify qualified components and alternative sources.
* Review component obsolescence and recommend replacement solutions.

**Testing & Validation**

* Develop electrical test plans, procedures, protocols, and acceptance criteria.
* Create product requirement documents and verification plans.
* Conduct design validation, functional testing, and performance evaluations.
* Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of electrical failures.
* Analyze test data and prepare reports with recommendations for corrective actions.
* Support qualification, reliability, and endurance testing activities.

**Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure products comply with applicable standards and regulations, including:
  + UL Standards
  + NEC (National Electrical Code)
  + IEC Standards
  + NFPA Requirements
  + NEMA Standards
* Support certification efforts with third-party agencies such as UL, ETL, and CSA.
* Review components and assemblies for regulatory compliance and safety requirements.
* Maintain compliance documentation and technical files.

**Manufacturing & Documentation Support**

* Develop and maintain assembly work instructions and manufacturing procedures.
* Provide engineering support to production and test technicians.
* Support manufacturing process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Review and update design documentation, specifications, and engineering records.
* Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and failure analysis activities.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of electrical engineering experience in manufacturing, industrial equipment, power distribution, automation, or related industries.
* Experience designing electrical control systems and power distribution equipment.
* Experience with product testing, validation, and technical documentation.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of electrical power systems and power distribution.
* Knowledge of electrical protection principles and component sizing.
* Experience with control system design and industrial automation.
* Electrical schematic design experience.
* Wiring harness and cable assembly design experience.
* Ability to troubleshoot electrical systems and identify root causes.
* Understanding of UL, NEC, IEC, NFPA, and NEMA standards.
* Experience developing test procedures, validation plans, and engineering specifications.
* Ability to read, interpret, and create technical drawings and documentation.
* Knowledge of component compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with busway, switchgear, panelboards, power distribution equipment, or industrial control panels.
* Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, SolidWorks Electrical, or similar design software.
* Experience with PLCs, HMIs, and industrial communication networks.
* Familiarity with ERP and PLM systems.
* Experience supporting UL or ETL product certification projects.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Experience working in a high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Electrical Design
* Power Distribution Systems
* Controls Engineering
* Electrical Testing & Validation
* Regulatory Compliance
* Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
* Technical Documentation
* Component Engineering
* Project Management
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Continuous Improvement

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in office, laboratory, and manufacturing environments.
* Ability to inspect equipment and perform hands-on testing activities.
* Occasional travel to suppliers, customers, testing laboratories, and manufacturing facilities as required.

Systems Engineer

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Projects:** KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

* **Collaborative Environment:** Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

* **Impactful Work:** Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

This Systems Engineer will demonstrate a strong interest in space and hands‑on engineering work. The role spans both physical telescope systems and the software used to command, control, and monitor them. The individual will support end‑to‑end deployment of small telescope systems, including designing mechanical adapters and interfaces, conducting camera studies and system burn‑in, and performing installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities. Work will be conducted at laboratory facilities and fielded observatory sites, including operations at high‑altitude locations such as Haleakalā Mountain, with additional travel to remote deployment locations as required.

**Responsibilities**

The individual will work as part of a high‑performance engineering team developing and sustaining advanced Space Domain Awareness (SDA) capabilities. This role supports the design, development, integration, verification, deployment, and long‑term maintenance of a network of Raven‑class small-aperture telescope systems. Responsibilities span system hardware and software across the full lifecycle, including hands-on integration and test, operational support, performance assessment, and fielded system sustainment.

This position performs a variety of engineering work in the development of an operable system capable of meeting requirements within imposed constraints including mass, cost and schedule. Designs and/or research subsystem interfaces to ensure that subsystems are integrated and work together to form a viable complete system. Performs functional analysis of a system to ensure it meets performance criteria and mission constraints and to feed the analysis results back to the subsystem development teams. Prepares design sketches and general equipment design of simple parts, subsystem interfaces, system layouts, etc. Performs relatively simple engineering and mathematical formulas and computations. Prepares analysis of technical data and information resulting from tests, studies, analysis, etc. Assisting other technical personnel in the preparation of technical reports, graphs and charts. May participate as a member of a team; primary contact is immediate supervisor. Performs all other duties as assigned.

Other responsibilities include:

* Operate, maintain, and sustain a geographically distributed network of small-aperture telescope systems in operational environments.
* Perform hands-on troubleshooting and repair of optical, mechanical, electrical, and software components to restore system functionality and performance.
* Support deployment, alignment, calibration, and commissioning of telescope systems in the field.
* Diagnose performance degradation at the system level and identify corrective maintenance or software updates.
* Execute preventative maintenance activities to maximize system uptime and operational availability.
* Maintain configuration control of hardware, firmware, and software across multiple deployed systems.
* Support remote operations, monitoring, and fault response for unattended telescope assets.
* Conceiving, designing, analyzing, simulating, overseeing, and assessing complex performance at the telescope system level.
* Ensuring the delivery of complex algorithms and software to system integration and test.
* Developing and implementing detailed test and verification plans from the subsystem.
* Validating and documenting the performance of these systems prior to delivering them to the customers.

**Qualifications**

This position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering

HPE Factory Build Process -DevID Software EngineerThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

The position is with the Product Security Office Team located within the Cybersecurity and Digital Risk Management organization. The position is responsible for providing coding and user support for the DevID service; a key component of HPE Factory Build process, that provides the PKI Certificate.

Candidate must be a US Citizen or currently have a Green Card.

This role will work with Teams across the United States and the world including Taiwan.

From a user support perspective, the candidate will need to work during USA hours since they will be the share responsibility with another USA-based team member to serve as the primary contact for assistance for HPE Factory Build process issues related to the DevID service. It will include late evenings, and weekends as needed.

From a code development perspective, the candidate will need to effectively work with the DeviD Architect/Software Development Lead on development and maintenance of the code base for new functionality, existing code revision and 'bug fixes' as needed. This work includes development test validation with focus on use of test automation.

In terms of a typical day, the candidate will

* Actively participate in DevID related meetings and calls during the USA hours
* Respond to emails from internal and external team members as needed
* If user support arises, it will be their primary responsibility until resolution and/or workaround is provided
* Work either as a team or individually on new code development and existing code revision; including creation/maintenance of automated test scripts for the DevID service.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Able to follow HPE processes for defect life cycle and build/release requirements with minimum guidance
* Able to follow current team coding standards; document, communicate, and implement in a timely fashion any required enhancements that are discovered during development, test, and integration – these changes are to be applied while enabling common source sharing
* Able to lead or participate in definition and finalization of Product Strategy and SPEC requirements for new DevID product functional needs
* Able to provide POC and Demonstrations as needed to help finalize requirements with usage of HPE agreed upon design tools
* Provide weekly status report on time; including progress against agreed to schedule tasks
* Maintain a quality focused with constant attention to detail. Not afraid to ask questions and/or provide feedback on strategy and/or issue resolution
* Must be assertive and self-driven that ensures timely and successful completion of all assigned tasks with minimal guidance
* Provide excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts at all levels of HPE management

**Job Requirements:**

* Candidate must be a US Citizen or currently have a Green Card due to the requirements of the role.
* 2+ years of applicable and documented technical experience in the following areas:
* GoLAN code development/maintenance as a pure-GoLAN service including experience with CGo build constraints (Linux vs Windows HSM shims), interface design, and the standard library crypto stack. (DevID Service) – Will maintain and extend a GoLAN -based REST microservices that issues X.509 DevID certificates to HPE hardware at HPE/third party Factory Build manufacturing and, in the field,
* Java and C code development/maintenance since they are used in our legacy code
* Applied cryptography experience: X.509 certificate chains, RSA, ECC. Ideally hands-on exposure to post-quantum algorithms (ML-DSA, ML-KEM including raw TPM wire-format parsing / CRYSTALS suite).
* Able to integrate with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) for both RSA and ML-DSA key operations, including partition management and key label conventions
* TPM 2.0 fundamentals: EK certificates, AK, attestation flows using go-tpm, TPMT\_PUBLIC wire format (public area parsing).
* Linux systems: The production target is containerized Linux; must have experience with Docker, nginx, and system d-level debugging
* Cybersecurity mindset: Familiarity with CNSA 2.0 requirements which are actively transitioning to CNSA 2.0 PQC algorithms.
* MariaDB, MS SQL Server SQL and MongoDB used for certificate and artifact tracking
* GitHub Repositories. Able to effectively support a multi-environment deployment model. Able to maintain CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, Docker multi-stage builds and a container registry deployment workflow
* Use of AI in generation of product SPEC definition, code development, code validation test and code security monitoring
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or equivalent work experience

**Preferred Technical Qualifications**

While not required for consideration, it would be beneficial if the candidate had a minimum of 6 months of applicable and documented technical experience in the following areas:

* Experience with DevID standards (IEEE 802.1AR)
* Experience with PKCS#11 / HSM: Understanding of key objects, handle vs label semantics, partition management; Thales Luna experience a plus.
