new_jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**The Opportunity**

A hands-on technical leadership role accountable for the architecture, engineering, and reliability of Abbott's enterprise AI Platform: the control plane and paved road that let teams build, deploy, and operate enterprise GenAI and agentic systems safely and quickly. This role is the technical counterpart to the Product Manager, AI Platform and partners with AI Product Managers, AI/Agentic Engineering, Applied Data Science, security, and division engineering teams. The role is Director-mapped and begins as a player-coach, with responsibility to grow and lead a platform engineering team.

**What You'll Do**

* Define and evolve the reference architecture for the AI control plane, paved-road services, SDKs, templates, and developer experience.
* Design and build a model gateway that supports multi-provider routing, failover, quota and rate limiting, tenant isolation, key management, token accounting, and cost allocation (e.g., a LiteLLM-style gateway over Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, or Vertex AI).
* Deliver a GenAI runtime for model serving, retrieval-augmented generation, context and memory stores, vector and hybrid search, sandboxed tool or code execution, secrets brokering, and MCP-style tool interoperability.
* Own the technical design of model, agent, prompt, and tool registries, including versioning, lineage, approval and promotion gates, deprecation, and auditability.
* Build platform observability and traceability for prompts, model calls, tool calls, and agent steps using distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions and Langfuse- or Arize-class tooling), with evaluation, quality, drift, latency, and cost signals.
* Implement security, guardrails, and responsible-AI controls in the platform, including PII/PHI handling, prompt-injection defenses, identity-on-behalf-of, least-privilege tool access, and policy enforcement.
* Establish platform engineering practices using Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, secure software development, capacity management, and reliability engineering. Define SLOs, participate in on-call, and lead incident response.
* Write and review production code, conduct architecture reviews, set engineering standards, and make pragmatic build-versus-buy and vendor recommendations with budget input.
* Hire, coach, and develop a platform engineering team of approximately 3–8 engineers; allocate work, set goals, and manage career development while remaining technically hands-on.
* Partner with the Product Manager, AI Platform to sequence the platform roadmap, communicate tradeoffs, and measure adoption, reliability, time-to-onboard, and consumer-team outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure experience, including significant technical leadership.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating enterprise AI/GenAI platforms or comparable developer, data, or ML platforms in production.
* Strong software engineering ability in Python and at least one of TypeScript, Go, or Java, with experience in APIs, distributed systems, testing, code review, and secure SDLC.
* Deep technical understanding of model gateways, GenAI runtimes, RAG, agent registries, evaluation, observability, traceability, guardrails, identity, and platform governance.
* Experience with containers and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud services, secrets management, and production SLOs and on-call practices.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions, influence across teams, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and manage a growing engineering team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise GenAI or agent platforms using capabilities such as multi-model routing, agent registries, prompt management, evaluation harnesses, and GenAI tracing.
* Experience in a highly regulated environment such as health tech, med-tech, or life sciences, with GxP, HIPAA, validation, auditability, and change-control constraints.
* Experience implementing security, responsible-AI, privacy, policy, and cost or FinOps controls for shared AI infrastructure.
* Experience with open standards and tooling such as MCP, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platform engineering practices.

**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.

* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.

* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

new_jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 115755

**Location:** Germantown, MD

**Business Unit:** DRS RADA Technologies

**Schedule:** 9/80

**Shift:** First

  

DRS RADA Technologies, a subsidiary of Leonardo DRS, is focused on proprietary radar solutions and legacy avionics systems supporting the defense industry globally. The company is a global pioneer of AESA tactical radars for active military protection, counter-drone applications, critical infrastructure protection, and border surveillance.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

DRS RADA Technologies is seeking a full-time, on-site Software Engineer II — Test Automation to build and maintain automated test tools, frameworks, and repeatable verification workflows for mission-critical radar and defense software. This hands-on role is part of the software organization and is ideal for an engineer who enjoys programming, scripting, automation, and troubleshooting to improve software quality, regression coverage, and release confidence. Prior radar, defense, or real-time software experience is helpful but not required; we value strong software fundamentals, practical automation experience, curiosity, and the ability to learn complex technical domains. Candidates with Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), test automation, software tools, or automation-focused software engineering backgrounds may be a strong fit.

**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

* Build, test, debug, and maintain automated test tools, scripts, frameworks, and test harnesses that support software verification and regression testing.
* Develop automated tests for software components, services, integrated workflows, and recurring regression scenarios.
* Convert manual or repeatable test procedures into automated tests, reusable utilities, and documented workflows.
* Support automated testing in Linux, Docker, virtual machine, simulation, and system-integration environments.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows and help improve the visibility, repeatability, and usefulness of test results.
* Work with software, systems, integration, and test engineers to understand expected behavior, reproduce issues, and improve test coverage.
* Support targeted automated testing of selected radar software components where practical.
* Document test automation tools and workflows so they can be reused and extended by the broader team.

**What You Bring:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least two years of relevant software, test automation, or software tools experience, or equivalent experience.
* Experience building automation tools, test scripts, test frameworks, or developer-facing software utilities.
* Strong programming ability in Python or another general-purpose programming language, with the ability to write maintainable code that can be reviewed, reused, and extended by other engineers.
* Experience testing, debugging, or troubleshooting software in development, integration, lab, or system-level environments.
* Familiarity with software test concepts such as unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, defect reproduction, automated test execution, and clear pass/fail criteria.
* Experience using Git and working in a collaborative software development or test environment.
* Ability to translate manual test procedures, expected behaviors, or recurring verification needs into automated tests, tools, or documented workflows.
* Experience with Linux-based environments, CI/CD workflows, Docker, virtual machines, message-based systems, embedded or real-time software, hardware/software integration, or mission-critical systems is helpful but not required.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively with software, systems, integration, and test engineers.
* U.S. citizenship is required. A current security clearance is not required, but the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance may be needed for future program work.

**What This Role Is Not:**
--------------------------

* This is not a manual-only test execution role; the focus is reusable automation, test frameworks, tools, and repeatable workflows.
* This is not a traditional test group position; the role is part of the software organization and works closely with development teams.
* This is not a cyber scanning, vulnerability remediation, radar algorithm development, or hardware technician role; the primary output of this role is software-based test automation.
* This is not a remote position; the role is full-time and on-site in Germantown, Maryland.
* This is not work performed in isolation; the engineer will collaborate closely with software, systems, integration, hardware, and test teams.

**What We Bring:**
------------------

At DRS RADA Technologies, your work supports technologies that help protect military personnel, critical infrastructure, and communities around the world. You will join a mission-driven team developing advanced radar technology that supports system performance and real-world defense applications.

  

We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company contribution to a health savings account; telemedicine; life and disability insurance; legal insurance; and a 401(k) savings plan. We invest in employee well-being, career growth, professional development, and skill enhancement, and offer a flexible 9/80 schedule, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.

U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

Job available in 2 locations

**Title:**

Senior Systems Engineer / Model-Based Systems Engineering Lead  
  

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

  
  

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.

  
  

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

  
  

*Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.*

  

The program team this engineer will join supports more than 20 projects across systems engineering, integration, and reliability engineering analysis for Naval Aviation. The selected candidate will become part of a collaborative KBR team where coordination across projects, disciplines, and technical leaders is encouraged by program leadership.

**Why Join Us?**

Innovative Projects: Support high-impact Naval Aviation work that applies modern engineering methods, emerging technologies, and mission-focused solutions to complex defense challenges.

Collaborative Environment: Work with experienced engineers, program leaders, and technical teammates in a collaborative setting that values coordination across projects and disciplines.

Impactful Work: Contribute directly to the engineering, integration, and sustainment of defense systems that support mission readiness and national security.

Career Growth: This project has rapid growth potential, with strong opportunities for increased responsibility, technical leadership, and potential upward mobility within the next 12 months as team and program needs evolve.

  

KBR is seeking a **Senior Systems Engineer / Model-Based Systems Engineering Lead** to support NAVAIR aircraft survivability and electronic warfare systems, primarily the AN/ALE-47 Countermeasures Dispensing System, Common Carriage program, and iASE Programmer development effort. The successful candidate will lead requirements development, system architecture, interface definition, integration planning, verification, and engineering coordination across government, platform, laboratory, and industry stakeholders. This role requires translating operational needs into clear, traceable, and verifiable technical requirements across hardware, software, cybersecurity, aircraft integration, testing, logistics, and sustainment activities in a collaborative defense acquisition environment. Work may include unclassified and classified activities, virtual and in-person technical meetings, and coordination with geographically distributed government organizations, aircraft platform teams, laboratories, and industry partners.

This position is expected to be approximately 75% remote; however, the selected candidate must reside near Patuxent River, MD, or King of Prussia, PA, for weekly in-person meetings and access to Secure Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) at these locations.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Lead systems engineering support for NAVAIR aircraft survivability and electronic warfare programs, with emphasis on the AN/ALE-47 Common Carriage system and iASE Programmer.

* Develop, review, decompose, allocate, trace, and verify system, subsystem, hardware, software, interface, cybersecurity, and verification requirements.

* Develop and maintain SysML system architecture models, requirements relationships, interface models, and black-box and white-box system representations using MBSE tools.

* Analyze electrical, data, control, and communication interfaces, including Ethernet, MIL-STD-1553, RS-422, discrete signals, aircraft power, secure connectivity, and mission-data loading.

* Coordinate cybersecurity, information assurance, configuration management, integration, qualification, and verification activities with platform teams, technical authorities, developers, testers, laboratories, and government stakeholders.

* Review contractor designs, specifications, interface documentation, engineering-change proposals, drawings, bills of material, test documentation, and configuration-controlled baselines.

* Support technical reviews, test planning, environmental and electromagnetic-interference qualification, laboratory and aircraft integration, performance verification, and requirements closure.

* Prepare technical briefings, engineering recommendations, trade studies, risk assessments, impact analyses, action-item responses, and decision-support products for program leadership.

* Provide day-to-day technical leadership, mentoring, staffing input, and coordination with government organizations, aircraft platform teams, laboratories, logistics organizations, and industry partners.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, computer engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related technical discipline,

new_jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate, small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we opened our Detroit manufacturing hub and field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

**The Role and Your Impact:**  
We need a Robotics Software Engineer who writes fast, correct C++ that runs on real hardware. You’ll work on the Archimedes stack alongside our Lead Software Engineer, taking raw sensor data and turning it into tracking, control and autonomy that has to work in real time. Performance and accuracy matter more than anything. Your scope grows as fast as you do; our Lead went from Founding Robotics Engineer to Lead in 12 months.

**What You’ll Own:**

* Production C++ across the stack: sensor ingestion, tracking, control and autonomy
* Working directly with drivers and raw sensor data, not pre-packaged inputs
* Threading, process architecture and performance on the paths you own
* Timing and latency analysis, and making the fixes it points to
* Python tooling for testing, analysis and the range
* Debugging on hardware at weekly field tests

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2+ years writing production C++ that runs on real hardware or real-time systems
* Comfort below the abstraction layer: threading, concurrency, memory, performance profiling
* You implement, not just design. You’ve shipped code you wrote
* Evidence you learn fast: you got effective in a new domain in months, not years

**Where you probably come from:** We’re domain agnostic. Robotics, AV, drones, aerospace, F1 or automotive, maritime, embedded systems, compilers, or low-level C++ game engine and 3D simulation work all fit. A robotics degree isn’t required; the robotics is learnable on the job.

**We want to talk if:** You’ve written C++ where latency or timing actually mattered and you measured it. Bonus if your projects touch motion planning, dynamics, trajectory optimization, or state estimation.

**Not a fit if:** You’re web, backend or full stack; your C++ is light and your real work is in Python; you’ve never had a full-time role; or you design systems but don’t implement them.

**Nice to Haves:**

* ROS2 (a good signal, though we've moved past it)
* Rust or other systems languages
* Sensor integration and calibration
* Real-time Linux

**Education:** BS, MS or PhD in CS, EE, Robotics or equivalent. Track record matters more than degree.

**How You Operate:**

* Extreme bias for action. You'd rather build a prototype tomorrow than model it for a month
* You characterize your own systems before the field does
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a startup environment
* You debug from first principles, not intuition alone
* Clear communicator across mechanical, electrical, optical, and software teams
* Self directed. You identify what needs to happen next and do it without being told

**Why Join Aurelius Systems:**

* Build more in 1 month than most engineers build in 1 year. We field test weekly. Your work goes downrange, not into a filing cabinet.
* Career velocity is real. With no middle management, there are no layers between you and impact.
* Work on a problem that actually matters. Small cheap drones are changing warfare. Our laser systems are the asymmetric answer — infinite magazine, near zero cost per shot, scalable to every base, border, facility, and truck.
* Join the densest defense startup ecosystem in the country. California is where the next generation of defense companies are being built.

**How We Work:**

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9 to 6. When we're sprinting toward a demo or field test, the team ramps up — nights, weekends, whatever it takes to ship. When the sprint lands, we ramp down. We don't manufacture intensity for show. If you've worked at SpaceX, against a mission-critical timeline, or on a racing team, you already know the rhythm.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and equity
* United Health Care medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible 18 days PTO plus 5 sick days
* Travel to field test events and range days
* Covered daily lunches and office snacks and drinks
* E-bike and scooter stipend up to $500
* Direct access to leadership and real ownership over your work

**Export Control Notice:**

This role requires access to export-controlled information or items that require U.S. Person status. As defined by U.S. law, individuals who are any one of the following are considered to be a U.S. Person: (1) U.S. citizens, (2) legal permanent residents (a.k.a. green card holders), and (3) certain protected classes of asylees and refugees, as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Compensation Range: $145K - $185K

new_jobs.description:
**Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior High Voltage Electronics Engineer to lead a technical team in designing, developing, and validating next-generation, high-efficiency power conversion systems. You will serve as both a technical authority and a team leader, guiding hardware architecture and driving planar transformer design, advanced thermal management, high-voltage component selection, and printed circuit board (PCB) development from concept to production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Guide, mentor, and align** cross-functional technical teams (software, mechanical, layout) to execute complex engineering projects from concept to production.
* **Design advanced thermal solutions** for high-power density PCBs, including thermal vias, heavy copper tracking, and insulation materials.
* **Integrate active and passive cooling systems** such as heat sinks, liquid cooling cold plates, or thermal interface materials (TIMs).
* **Design and optimize** planar transformers and planar inductors for high-frequency, high-voltage power converters.
* **Lead high-voltage PCB layout** architectures, integrating embedded winding structures for planar magnetics.
* **Establish creepage,** clearance, and isolation boundaries per safety standards.
* **Simulate circuits, magnetics, and thermal performance** using SPICE, PLECS, and thermal analysis tools (e.g., Ansys Icepak, Flotherm).
* **Create schematics** and oversee multi-layer, high-density, high-voltage PCB designs.
* **Lead hardware testing**, debugging, and compliance validation under extreme thermal conditions in the lab.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (master’s or Ph.D. preferred).
* **Experience**: Minimum of 5+ years in high-voltage hardware. board design and project leadership.
* **Thermal & Cooling Design Expertise**: Proven success in thermal management for high-power electronics, including PCB cooling strategies and heat sink integration.
* **Strategic Thinking**; Demonstrated strategic technical and market strategy development and implementation.
* **High Familiarity with Planar Magnetics**: Direct experience designing, optimizing, and manufacturing planar transformers.
* **Leadership Skills**: At least 4+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing engineering teams.
* **PCB Expertise**: Proven success designing multi-layer PCBs for 400V to 1kV+ environments.
* **Tools**: Proficiency with Altium Designer or Cadence Allegro, alongside thermal simulation software.
* **Standards**: Strong knowledge of safety and manufacturing specs (IPC-2221, IPC-2152, UL 60950/62368).

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with FEA/CFD simulation tools for thermal analysis like Ansys Icepak, Flotherm, or SolidWorks Flow Simulation.
* Knowledge of advanced substrate materials like Insulated Metal Substrates (IMS) or ceramic PCBs (AlN, Al2O3).
* Experience mitigating partial discharge and arcing risks in dense board and planar winding designs.
* Background in automotive EV powertrain systems or renewable energy grid storage.
* Strong understanding of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and EMI mitigation.

The Lead Systems Engineer will provide Systems engineering design expertise to the Data Transfer Systems product team. Systems is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on the product development approach, mindset, and process and includes activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user’s needs. Systems is the discipline that executes a robust process of design, analysis, approach tradeoffs, creation, optimization, integration and verification. The Systems role consists of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs, integration of the subsystems that comprise the design, and the verification that the resulting design fully meets its requirements.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design of the electronics inside our machine vision systems: camera and sensor boards, laser and LED illumination drivers, motion and trigger interfaces, and the power and I/O that connect our inspection heads to production lines.

You will own designs from concept through schematics, layout, release to purchasing, and production working closely with optics, firmware, software, purchasing, and manufacturing teams. Our systems run 24/7 on factory floors, so reliability, signal integrity and EMC matter as much as performance.

Location: Ann Arbor, MI · Type: Full-time

Key responsibilities

You will own each design end to end, from first concept through release to purchasing:

* Concept and requirements: translate product and customer needs into electrical requirements, block diagrams and architecture trade studies
* Circuit design: design mixed-signal circuits for 2D/3D vision sensors, including image sensor interfaces, high-speed digital (MIPI CSI-2, LVDS, GigE/10GigE, USB3, PCIE), FPGA/SoC carrier boards, laser and LED strobe drivers, low-noise power, SBC interfaces and trigger and encoder inputs
* Component selection: choose parts for performance, cost, lifecycle and supply availability; identify second sources
* Schematic capture: create complete, review-ready schematics with clear documentation
* PCB layout: lay out multilayer, controlled-impedance boards yourself, including stackup definition, placement, routing and constraints for high-speed, analog and power sections
* Analysis and simulation: perform signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and worst-case analyses (SPICE, IBIS, SI/PI tools)
* Prototype build and bring-up: release prototype builds, then debug and validate with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum and network analyzers
* Verification and compliance: write and run design verification tests; lead EMC and safety compliance (CE, FCC, UL/IEC 61010, IEC 60825-1 laser safety)
* Design release: generate fabrication and assembly packages (Gerbers/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings, pick-and-place), release controlled BOMs with approved manufacturer part numbers, and manage revisions through ECOs
* Hand-off to purchasing and production: work with purchasing on sourcing, lead times and alternates; support contract manufacturers with DFM/DFT feedback, test fixtures, failure analysis and obsolescence

Across every stage you will also:

* Partner with firmware engineers on FPGA/MCU interfaces, timing and camera control
* Support customers and field engineers integrating with PLCs, robots and industrial networks (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, digital I/O)
* Lead design reviews and mentor junior engineers

**Required qualifications**

* BS in Electrical Engineering or related field
* 7+ years designing electronic hardware, with at least one product taken from concept through BOM release, purchasing hand-off and volume production
* Strong mixed-signal design skills: high-speed digital, precision analog and switch-mode power
* Hands-on schematic capture and PCB layout (you do your own layout) with Altium Designer, including multilayer, controlled-impedance boards
* Experience with FPGA or SoC-based hardware (e.g., AMD/Xilinx, Intel/Altera, NVIDIA Jetson)
* Proficient with lab equipment and systematic hardware debugging
* Working knowledge of EMC design practices and regulatory compliance testing
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting design trade-offs

Preferred qualifications

* MS in Electrical Engineering
* Familiarity with Comm Express platforms and Computer Architecture
* Experience in machine vision, 3D sensing (laser triangulation, structured light, time-of-flight) or industrial cameras
* Familiarity with CMOS image sensor characteristics: noise, dynamic range, global vs. rolling shutter
* Laser driver and eye-safety design experience (IEC 60825-1 Class 2/3R)
* Industrial electronics for harsh environments: 24 V I/O, isolation, surge/ESD protection, IP-rated enclosures
* Exposure to automotive, battery or electronics manufacturing customers
* Scripting for test automation (Python, MATLAB) and basic firmware skills (C/C++)

What we offer

* Ownership of core hardware in products that inspect parts on real production lines
* A small, hands-on team where your designs ship and you see the results
* Competitive salary, bonus and equity
* Medical, dental and vision coverage; 401(k) with company match

### **Description**

We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area.  
  
More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation!  
  
SmartThings is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join the Components and Device Actions (CODA) team. CODA owns the core device and location cloud services that the rest of the SmartThings platform builds on: how devices are described, organized, and managed, and how homes and their contents are represented and handed between owners. You'll join a tight-knit team of experienced engineers running mission-critical services at scale, with a roadmap that spans new platform capabilities, modernization of our stack, and growing demand from enterprise customers. It's a role with real influence over where these services go next.  
  
This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!).

The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.

### **Key Responsibilities**

In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:

* **Technical Strategy:** Chart the long-term direction for one or more CODA domains so our device and location services keep pace with platform growth.
* **Complex Initiatives:** Own large, ambiguous, multi-team efforts from first sketch to well-run production launch.
* **Architecture for Reliability & Scale:** Steer design for the services behind device capabilities, device groups, locations, and ownership transfer, including event-driven state processing and the demands of enterprise customers. Reliability, performance, and security shape the design from day one.
* **Platform Modernization:** Lead the evolution of our stack while balancing security, maintainability, and cost.
* **AI Practices & Vision:** Shape how the team adopts AI-assisted development and operational tooling, deciding where it genuinely improves speed and quality.
* **Partnership Across Teams:** Work alongside global platform, product, and partner teams that build on CODA, keeping priorities aligned with product needs and business goals.
* **Mentorship & Team Growth:** Coach engineers at every level and build habits that lift the bar across the organization.
* **Service Ownership:** SmartThings teams run what they build. You'll share responsibility for production support, from planning through deployment.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**What You Bring On Day One (Required Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of production software engineering with a record of Staff-level leadership
* Fluency in JVM languages (Java, Kotlin, etc.) and frameworks (Spring Boot, Micronaut, etc).
* A hands-on record designing and operating distributed microservices and RESTful APIs on AWS at scale, with Terraform and Docker in your toolkit
* Sound judgment across data and messaging layers: DynamoDB versus relational stores, and event-driven systems built on Kafka or similar
* Working knowledge of AI development tools and practices
* Proven ability to lead design reviews, steer direction across teams, and turn complex problems into simple solutions, with clear written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences

**Desired Skills**

* Zero-downtime migrations and large-scale data backfills on live systems
* Observability, failure testing, and disciplined release practices
* Kubernetes and container orchestration in production
* Agentic coding tools, and a habit of sharing what works
* Multi-tenant platforms with permissions, usage limits, and rate limiting

  

### **SmartThings Benefits**

  

* We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life & disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more.

In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance.

new_jobs.title: OT Systems Engineer (Physical Infrastructure)
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

SpaceXSI is looking for a highly skilled and versatile OT (Operational Technology) Systems Engineer to implement and support the backend infrastructure for our next-generation controls and industrial software platforms for our physical infrastructure. This role is embedded within the mission IT organization to provide support to dedicated controls engineering organizations while leveraging adjacent IT expertise, tooling, and technologies. This role will balance support of legacy controls support systems with modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in high stakes settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and combines deep OT expertise with IT technologies such as virtualization, VDI, GitOps, network level redundancy and edge compute solutions to create streamlined and secure ICS environments.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, deploy, and augment next-generation OT environments that support plant and launch systems across multiple sites.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support industry standard controls software platforms as well as internally developed HMIs.
* Integrate established and emergent IT technologies to simplify management, improve security, and create scalable plant environments.
* Deploy and maintain development, test, and staging environments to enable controlled, systematic change introduction.
* Provide direct support during launch, test, and production campaigns.
* Perform systems/software upgrades and maintenance between critical operations (including evenings and weekends as needed).
* Proactively monitor services and respond rapidly to incidents to maintain high availability and performance.
* Leverage automation tools and contribute to infrastructure-as-code and broader DevOps initiatives with a focus on ICS environments.
* Work with internal controls engineers to iterate on simulation and emulation environment to enhance test coverage and augment change control processes.
* Write and maintain standards, architectures, best practices, and documentation (including system overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures), with emphasis on highly reliable and secure industrial environments, especially at data boundaries.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, security, controls, and operations) as well as external customers and integrators to design robust OT architectures and resolve technical issues.
* Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3+ years of experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration.
* Hands-on experience with multiple industry standard controls software platforms and tools.
* Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting OT environments in high-reliability settings.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.
* Experience designing architectures that incorporate hyperconverged, rugged industrial edge, and distributed compute technologies.
* Working knowledge of industrial protocols, controls networks, and OT cybersecurity best practices.
* Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Puppet, Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
* Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and DevOps concepts/tools.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, multi-platform authentication, and identity environments in OT contexts.
* System administration experience managing Windows and Linux servers, rudimentary database administration exposure, and storage/backup experience.
* Network administration experience and understanding of the OSI model, especially Layer 1/2/3 considerations as they apply to industrial and controls networks.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.
* Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.
* Ability to lift 30 lbs.
* Ability to work at heights.
* Ability to drive (active valid driver's license).

new_jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Power Generation) - Memphis
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join the power generation engineering team to design, commission, and maintain plant control systems. As a Controls Engineer, you will own BOP PLC/HMI and the control-room SCADA picture that brings generation and balance-of-plant into one operating view — Solar, 6000, and BOP on a single set of screens. You will work from control philosophy through commissioning and ongoing reliability, hands-on at the panel and in the control room. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own BOP PLC and HMI design, programming, and commissioning for power generation balance-of-plant systems (fuel gas, water, compressed/instrument air, HVAC, cooling, electrical auxiliaries, and related process/utility systems)

* Design and maintain the plant SCADA architecture so operators have one operating picture in the control room integrating Solar, 6000, and BOP — graphics, alarms, historian, and situational awareness on a single platform

* Develop control philosophy, control narratives, I/O lists, network drawings, cause-and-effect diagrams, and HMI/SCADA standards for reuse across the facility

* Specify PLC, HMI, SCADA, remote I/O, industrial networking, and interface hardware; define data exchange with OEM turbine/generation controllers (Solar and 6000) and with electrical protection, metering, and plant systems

* Program, test, and troubleshoot PLC logic and HMI applications (IEC 61131 — ladder, function block, structured text as applicable)

* Integrate OEM packages and third-party systems into plant SCADA using industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, IEC 61850, and others as required) so Solar, 6000, and BOP operate as one system

* Commission controls: I/O checkout, loop checks, functional testing, HMI validation, alarm rationalization, and start-up support; stay hands-on with technicians and operators

* Support day-to-day operations: troubleshooting, sequence issues, bad actors, and control changes under MOPs/MOC

* Maintain configuration management for PLC/HMI/SCADA programs, as-left files, firmware, and network documentation

* Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, fluids, protection, and operations so controls scope is fully integrated through construction, commissioning, and turnover

* Apply relevant standards for industrial control systems and electrical work (NFPA 70 / 70E, IEC 61131, and site cybersecurity/ICS practices such as NERC CIP where applicable)

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, controls engineering, computer engineering, or another engineering discipline

* 3+ years of experience in PLC, HMI, and/or SCADA engineering (design, programming, or commissioning) on industrial or power generation systems

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years in a controls role at a power plant, independent power producer, OEM, EPC, or heavy industrial facility

* Hands-on BOP PLC/HMI experience on gas turbine or similar generation projects

* Experience building a unified control-room SCADA/HMI that aggregates multiple OEM controllers (e.g. Solar, 6000, or equivalent turbine packages) with plant BOP

* Familiarity with major platforms (e.g. Ignition, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Emerson, GE, SEL) and industrial networking (IT/OT)

* Experience with IEC 61131 programming and protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, and IEC 61850

* Experience across the project lifecycle: design, programming, construction support, commissioning, and operations

* Experience with alarm management, historian, and control-room graphics that operators actually use

* Working knowledge of how BOP controls interface with electrical power systems (switchgear, protection, metering) without owning relay settings

* Experience managing OEM and contractor interfaces on multi-discipline power or capital projects

* Professional Engineering license, or actively working toward one

* Ability to support technicians in the field and to remain effective during outages, start-up, and event investigations

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to perform hands-on work in the plant and control room, including during outages and commissioning

* Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support power generation operations

* Must be able to work on-site in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other SpaceXSI facilities

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

We’re looking for a skilled and forward-thinking **Ctrl Systems Engineer / Automation Engineer (AE)** to join our growing team as we work to service one of the world’s largest online retailers.

Come join our global network of professionals supporting client operations across CBRE. Looking for growth and career advancement? Upon completing six months of successful service, associates may explore career advancement opportunities within the organization!

Read on to learn more!

In this vital engineering role, you will be part of a team of controls and maintenance professionals who proactively support operations and provide customers with expert-level support based on the customer’s technical problems related to their automated material handling equipment (MHE). Your expertise will be utilized in the continuous improvement and execution of the preventive maintenance process, with a focus on maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance of equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, SCADA deves and programs.

* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.

* 2+ years of experience with Programmable Logic Controls (PLC) programs.
* 2+ years of experience with robotics system components and controls.
* 2+ years of experience with SCADA systems.
* Ability to be available and work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

CBRE Employee Benefits

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision
* Disability benefit program

* Paid time off and holidays

* Pet insurance

  + Power monitoring hardware and software.

* Professional Engineering (PE) license.
* Ability to read and understand power and control schematics.

* Experience with variable frequency drives (VFDs) and industrial pumps.
* Experience with controls in MODBUS communication.

* Working knowledge of power coordination and arc flash.
* Ability to work on multiple tasks concurrently.

* Good organizational skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

new_jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor - Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The School of Computing (SoC) at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln (UNL) is undergoing strategic expansion and invites applications for a tenured/tenure-track faculty position at the Assistant or Associate Professor rank to begin in Fall 2027. SoC offers a collegial, collaborative culture and broad opportunities for interdisciplinary research across campus. We seek exceptional candidates who can establish a substantial scholarly research and teaching program in Software Engineering focused on improving the dependability, safety, and/or security of AI-based software systems. The successful candidate will join a rapidly growing Software Engineering community with opportunities to collaborate across AI, cybersecurity, robotics, agriculture, health, and data science initiatives at UNL.

  

**Position Description**

The successful candidate will pursue a strong research program in Software Engineering, with particular emphasis on methods, tools, and foundations for improving the dependability, safety, and security of AI-based software systems. We are especially interested in research addressing the design, development, testing, verification, validation, deployment, and evolution of software incorporating machine learning and deep learning models, generative AI and large language models, AI agents and agentic systems, autonomous systems, and cyber-physical systems. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to, testing and debugging of AI-enabled software; verification and validation of learning-enabled and agentic systems; formal methods and software assurance for trustworthy AI; safety, security, and reliability of autonomous and cyber-physical systems; explainability and interpretability as they relate to software assurance; integration of assurance techniques into modern software engineering workflows; and program analysis and other software engineering techniques for improving system dependability. While these areas are of particular interest, we welcome applicants whose research spans the broader field of Software Engineering.

The successful candidate will be expected to establish and maintain a vigorous, externally funded research program in Software Engineering or a closely related area. They will contribute to both undergraduate and graduate education through teaching of core courses in our Software Engineering program, mentoring graduate and undergraduate researchers, and offering courses aligned with their area of expertise. Additional responsibilities include active participation in school, college, and university governance, contributions to curriculum development, and engagement in interdisciplinary collaborations with partners across campus as well as in industry, government, and national laboratories. Candidates at the Associate Professor rank should demonstrate a sustained record of scholarly achievement, research leadership, external funding, graduate student mentoring, and national or international visibility in their field.

To support research success, the position includes a competitive startup package designed to establish a strong research program. This package provides funding for equipment, graduate student support, and research expenses, along with a reduced teaching load during the initial years. The successful candidate will also have access to modern laboratory space in our state-of-the-art facilities and shared departmental resources, including advanced computational infrastructure provided through Holland Computing Center (**hcc.unl.edu**).

**School of Computing Overview**

The SoC is undergoing an exciting period of significant growth and has hired 14 tenured/tenure-track faculty members since 2019. We are committed to promoting excellence among our faculty and seek to attract and retain a high-performing workforce in which employees’ differences are respected and valued to meet the varying needs of the populations we serve.

SoC is recognized for its work in Empirical Software Engineering, Testing, Formal Methods, and Mining Software Repositories, and is expanding into areas such as Software Security, Software Engineering in Robotics, and Human-centered Software Engineering. SoC is enhancing research in Data Science, AI, and Machine Learning, recently introducing a new Data Science undergraduate major, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Master’s degree and Graduate Certificate program, and undergraduate AI minor, aiming to develop impactful programs in health, agriculture, biocomputing, and robotics. The school also leads a Cybersecurity Initiative to tackle security challenges with AI and ML techniques. Additionally, SoC is a leader in IoT and Agricultural IoT, spearheading the Nebraska IoT Initiative through a public-private partnership. This includes collaborations on significant infrastructure projects and the formation of the interlocal agency iLNK. Furthermore, the NIMBUS lab excels at developing Uncrewed Aircraft Systems for agricultural and scientific applications and contributes to the $25 million Heartland Robotics Cluster.

**College Growth**

The College of Engineering has hired more than 70 new faculty members over the past five years and continues to grow its faculty base to support future expansion. **ELECTRICAL ENGINEER - R&D**

**Hackettstown, New Jersey | Flexible Hybrid Schedule | Research & Development**

  

**WHY WORK FOR ASTRODYNE TDI?**

Astrodyne TDI develops power technologies and products that people depend on to enhance, protect, and save lives. With more than 60 years of power supply design experience, our technology supports demanding industrial, semiconductor, medical, aerospace, defense, and other critical-market applications.

**Hands-on innovation:** Turn advanced power-electronics and digital-control concepts into working hardware.

**Complete development cycle:** Work across simulation, architecture, circuit design, embedded firmware, prototyping, laboratory testing, and production readiness.

**Advanced technologies:** Gain exposure to digital power control, high-performance conversion topologies, and SiC and GaN devices.

**Technical collaboration:** Solve complex real-world problems alongside experienced engineers who value curiosity and teamwork.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Astrodyne TDI is seeking a motivated R&D Electrical Engineer who is excited about power electronics, digital control, and turning innovative concepts into working hardware. This hands-on role contributes to advanced switch-mode power supplies, digital control systems, and high-performance power conversion technologies. The engineer will work across simulation, circuit design, embedded firmware, prototyping, laboratory validation, troubleshooting, and cross-functional production support.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**Design & Develop Advanced Power Electronics**

* Design, prototype, and evaluate switch-mode power converters, including PFC, resonant LLC, phase-shifted full-bridge, buck, and boost topologies.
* Contribute to power architecture, circuit design, component selection, and design optimization.
* Develop high-reliability power conversion solutions for demanding industrial, medical, aerospace, and defense applications.

**Develop Digital Power Control**

* Implement real-time digital control loops for switch-mode power stages using Texas Instruments C2000 microcontrollers.
* Develop and test C/C++ firmware using TI C2000 peripherals, including ePWM, Type IV PWM, CMPSS, and high-speed ADCs.
* Optimize control-loop performance, transient response, stability, and protection functions.

**Model, Simulate & Analyze**

* Model power converters and closed-loop control systems using SIMPLIS, SIMetrix, QSpice, or comparable tools.
* Perform transient analysis, AC sweeps, control-loop stability analysis, and frequency-response evaluation.
* Validate continuous-to-discrete control-loop transitions and use simulation results to guide hardware development.

**Build, Test & Troubleshoot**

* Take designs from simulation and schematic through prototype development and laboratory validation.
* Conduct electrical, thermal, efficiency, stress, and reliability testing.
* Troubleshoot complex power-conversion and control issues using oscilloscopes, electronic loads, power analyzers, network analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.
* Analyze test results and translate findings into practical design improvements.

**Advance Power Technologies & Compliance**

* Support gate-driver design and switching-stage optimization.
* Evaluate switching losses and performance of MOSFET, SiC, and GaN power devices.
* Consider high-frequency magnetics, PCB layout, parasitics, thermal management, and EMI throughout the design.
* Participate in design verification, EMI/EMC troubleshooting, and product qualification activities.
* Support testing and documentation for applicable requirements, including MIL-STD-461 and UL/IEC 62368.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Quality, and other teams to advance designs toward production.

**WHAT YOU BRING - REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering required; a master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Electronics is a plus.
* 2-5 years of hands-on experience in switch-mode power supply design, power electronics, and/or digital control.
* Practical experience with Texas Instruments C2000 microcontrollers, Code Composer Studio, and C2000Ware.
* Solid understanding of classical and digital control concepts, including peak current mode, average current mode, and voltage mode control.
* Experience modeling power converters and closed-loop control systems using SIMPLIS, SIMetrix, QSpice, or comparable tools.
* Familiarity with high-frequency magnetic components, including inductors and transformers.
* Understanding of PCB layout considerations for high-frequency power electronics.
* Strong laboratory troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively and collaborate in a cross-functional engineering environment.

**PREFERRED BACKGROUND**

* Experience with SiC and/or GaN wide-bandgap semiconductors.
* Experience with high-voltage power-conversion topologies.
* Proficiency with Cadence OrCAD Capture, Allegro PCB Editor, or comparable schematic and PCB tools.
* Familiarity with hardware-in-the-loop testing or rapid-prototyping platforms.
* Experience with EMI/EMC testing and troubleshooting.
* Experience developing power supplies for regulated, safety-critical, medical, aerospace, or defense applications.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

**$95,000-$120,000 annually.**Final compensation will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and other business considerations.

Astrodyne TDI offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, financial well-being, and overall quality of life.

**READY TO POWER WHAT IS NEXT?**

**If you are an electrical engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems, working with both hardware and software, and turning ideas into real-world technology, apply today. Join Astrodyne TDI and help develop power technologies that people depend on to enhance, protect, and save lives.**

*Astrodyne TDI is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action

Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

**Posting Open Date: 10/05/2026**

**Anticipated Posting Close Date\*: 12/05/2026**

* *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.*

**Software Engineer**

We are looking for a full-stack software engineer to join Fastly’s Platform Observability and Intelligence (POI) team.

The POI team is responsible for:

* Fastly's internal observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and more), spanning cloud infrastructure and physical hardware.
* Fastly's internal developer portal, built on Backstage.
* An internal set of tools and data pipelines that synthesize network and financial data to provide insights into network costs, capacity planning, and related business concerns.

We are specifically looking for someone to contribute to the first two items on this list, though you will work across all of our software.

This is a generalist, mid-level position, ideal for someone with a few years of experience who is seeking to grow their career. We are looking for an engineer who is curious, proactive, and eager to grow into an impactful role. You will work broadly and deeply, contribute meaningfully to projects that affect how Fastly engineers understand and operate their services, and build toward owning larger pieces of work over time.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, build and maintain software and platform capabilities that power Fastly’s internal observability function and developer experience
* Contribute to the development of our internal developer portal, helping engineering teams discover services, documentation, and operational tooling all in one place
* Work with your team to break down project requirements into concrete tasks, and take ownership of your assigned work through to completion
* Debug and resolve issues across the software stack, from datacenter hardware to the browser, often spanning multiple services and data sources
* Communicate clearly about the status of your work and any problems you encounter. Write useful updates, ask good questions, and raise issues early rather than at the deadline
* Collaborate with other engineers on the team. Provide thoughtful code review and share context and knowledge.
* Participate constructively in team planning and retrospectives
* Participate in on-call rotation as required, and respond to incidents within the team's SLA while on-call.

**What We're Looking For:**

Technical skills:

* 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver quality work on reasonably well-defined projects with limited oversight
* Experience in a statically typed, modern back-end language (Go, Java, Rust, etc.)
* Experience in modern front-end frameworks (React, etc.), or a willingness to dive in and become proficient
* Experience with SQL and database-driven applications
* Experience working with Linux systems and the shell
* Experience working with distributed systems or cloud-based services, and an interest in developing deeper expertise in operating and debugging them
* Comfort with large and unfamiliar codebases: jumping into a system you didn't build, figuring out the context, and contributing with confidence. Our stack is broad, and you will regularly work in code you haven't seen before, including code written at Fastly and open-source codebases.

### **The Position**

**Senior Principal Robotics Engineer - CVRM**

ITOT supports Pharma Technical Manufacturing (PTM), PTM is responsible for managing all aspects of end-to-end drug substance and drug product manufacturing and supply. From the raw material to the final medicine, we contribute to delivering Roche’s ground-breaking therapies to more than 120 million patients around the world. We make our medicines at nine sites around the world and coordinate all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms. To ensure readiness for a step-change in the standard of care that Roche delivers in the area of Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM), PTM will construct a new manufacturing site in the U.S. in Holly Spring, North Carolina. ITOT will own and operate Manufacturing Technology stack at the site working with Global IT. The new site will focus on large volume low-cost Drug Product manufacturing (Component Prep & Compounding, Liquid PFS Filling, Automated Inspection, Autoinjector Assembly, Packaging/Finished Products).

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Principal Robotics Engineer will build, gain approval for, and fully implement the comprehensive robotics program for the Holly Springs Greenfield project. The role is essential for transforming the site's manual operations into a "Smart Factory" model, targeting a state-of-the-art Highly Automated Warehouse and the integration of Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) throughout the facility.

Initially, you will perform a mix of remote and onsite work (first at the General Planner’s office, later at construction site/plant). You will transition to local full-time on-site work once the site buildings are built and equipment delivered. Eventually, you will transition into the site-based robotics systems owner and provide site operations support on robotics. Travel of up to 30% of the time is expected during the project phase.

**What You Will Do**

* **Program Development & Implementation:** Create full context about the Holly Springs Robotics strategy to hone, get approval, and implement the comprehensive Holly Springs robotics program.
* **System Ownership & Support:** Eventually become the dedicated site-based robotics systems owner and provide ongoing, 24/7 site operations support on robotics once the facility goes live.
* **Team Leadership:** Possibly manage a team of robotics engineers in the future, scaling the team based on business needs and commercial filling requirements.
* **Robotics PIT Leadership:** Serve on the Robotics Project Implementation Team (PIT) to focus on robotics and technical enablement, implementation of industry standards, and ensuring seamless compatibility, connectivity, and data integrity.
* **Smart Factory Integration:** Lead the transition of manual operations into a "Smart Factory" model, integrating Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), AGVs (e.g., MiR, Geek+), and ASRS systems across end-to-end flows (kitting, filling, packaging, waste handling).
* **Strategy & Roadmap Creation:** Formulate a capability roadmap and investment case to articulate the ROI of robotic interventions based on labor savings, ergonomic risks, and increased facility uptime.
* **System Qualification:** Support end-to-end system qualification, including test creation, execution, and approval, working alongside IT/OT to integrate robotics into the digital twin and enterprise architecture.
* **Safety & Compliance:** Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, and adhere to site SOPs and work instructions for daily and project deliverables.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Computer Science preferred) and 10 years of experience, or Master’s degree in Engineering and 8 years of experience.
* Proven experience in program creation and cross-functional project management, with the capability and ambition to eventually manage a team of robotics engineers.
* Able to provide 24X7 support and participate in an on-call environment to meet business continuity requirements, including weekends and holidays as required.
* Experience in pharmaceutical/biotech robotics or automated manufacturing environments is highly preferred.
* Deep knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Health Authority practices, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP Annex 11, and Data Integrity principles is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* **Demonstrated Robotics Experience:** Proven, hands-on technical proficiency in designing, deploying, configuring, and maintaining robotics systems, including Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), and automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS).
* **System Integration:** Demonstrated expertise in integrating robotics with enterprise and manufacturing systems like SAP EWM, WCS (Körber K.One.X), and MES platforms.
* **Fleet Management:** Deep understanding of AGV/AMR fleet management software (FMS), navigation technologies (Laser, Natural, Magnetic), and dynamic traffic tuning.
* **Troubleshooting & Diagnostics:** Proficiency in troubleshooting robotics hardware, sensor calibration, safety fields, and PLC communication protocols (e.g., Profinet/EtherNet/IP).
* **Industry Awareness:** Keeps abreast of key Manufacturing IT and Robotics trends - Industrial IoT, Digital Plant Maturity, Pharma 4.0, and automated cleanroom sampling.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Holly Springs, North Carolina is $114,400 - $212,400. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

**Benefits**

**Relocation benefits are available for this job posting.**
