**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**About Us**

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Copeland is looking for a controls engineer on our Oil Free Centrifugal (OFC) development team. Our OFC compressors are sold to system manufacturers in HVAC and Data Center applications. It is a fast-paced and demanding environment as we adjust to customer requests. The main focus of the job will be development of the Human Machine Interface (HMI) program for the compressor with additional responsibilities supporting the compressor control logic. **The job is based in Sidney, OH with some opportunity for remote work. We will not be able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.**

  

**As a Centrifugal Controls Engineer, you will:**

* Work safely within office and lab testing environments, holding others to safety standards.
* Create, modify and test compressor HMI applications (currently in C#).
* Support compressor test team with lab controls, technician HMI views, and data recording.
* Document and track issue and feature requests in GitHub.
* Support application engineers with customer questions and troubleshooting.
* Support DFMEA reviews for controls and control hardware.
* Modify and test compressor control logic using structured text and function block diagram languages.
* Document control changes in internal specifications and customer manuals.
* Travel to customer locations for system control support and field troubleshooting (minimal time).
* Support compressor development team on control hardware selection and testing.
Support power electronics (variable frequency drive) development team with compressor controller and drive interactions.  

  

**Schedule:**

This role is hybrid eligible with the requirement to be in office at least three days per week. Colleagues are expected to demonstrate a collaboration first mindset, which is the understanding that teams will work together in-person and colleagues should be flexible to adjust their hybrid days based on business needs. You will have an opportunity to work with your team and leader to determine when you should be in office to drive meaningful connections and to best serve our customers.

  

**Required education, experiences & skills:**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering or related discipline.
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in industrial controls, application programming, electronics integration, or similar.
* Experience with programming languages (Industrial PLC/DCS, C#, Python, etc.).
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Ability to balance multiple projects in fast-paced engineering environment.
* Available to travel up to 10%, including internationally.
Legal Authorization to work in the United States - Sponsorship will not be provided for this role  

**Preferred education, experiences & skills:**

**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.

* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

new_jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

**Automation Engineer**

**CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity.**

Job Summary

At **CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS)**, Safety is our top priority! We maintain a safety-first culture in which CBRE employees return home in the same condition in which they reported to work. We’re looking for a skilled and forward-thinking **Ctrl Systems Engineer / Automation Engineer (AE)** to join our growing team as we work to service one of the world’s largest online retailers.

We offer competitive pay, robust benefits package, wellness programs, and a workplace environment that embraces diversity. Come join our global network of professionals supporting client operations across CBRE. Looking for growth and career advancement? Upon completing six months of successful service, associates may explore career advancement opportunities within the organization!

Read on to learn more!

About the Role

In this vital engineering role, you will be part of a team of controls and maintenance professionals who proactively support operations and provide customers with expert-level support based on the customer’s technical problems related to their automated material handling equipment (MHE). Your expertise will be utilized in the continuous improvement and execution of the preventive maintenance process, with a focus on maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance of equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, SCADA deves and programs.

What You’ll Do

* Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety.
* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.
* Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed.
* Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieves operational conditions prescribed by the client.
* Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems.
* Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation.
* Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.
* Perform controls of systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability.
* Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and the maintenance teams.
* Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members.
* Perform other job-related duties as needed or assigned.

What You’ll Need

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience with Programmable Logic Controls (PLC) programs.
* 2+ years of experience with robotics system components and controls.
* 2+ years of experience with SCADA systems.
* Ability to be available and work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

CBRE Employee Benefits

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision
* Disability benefit program
* 401k company matching
* Paid time off and holidays
* Company paid life insurance
* Pet insurance
* Paid parental leave

new_jobs.title: Protection & Controls Engineer - Memphis
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join the High Power Engineering team to design, set, commission, and maintain protection and control systems for large electrical infrastructure. As a Protection & Controls Engineer, you will own schemes and settings from the transmission interconnection through distribution, on-site generation, and battery energy storage, down to medium- and low-voltage buses serving data halls and other mission-critical loads. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop protection philosophy, one-line and three-line diagrams, DC control schematics, wiring diagrams, and relay panel layouts for the electrical system from the utility interconnection to facility buses.
* Calculate, implement, and maintain protective relay settings and logic for transmission lines, buses, power transformers, distribution feeders, generators, and battery energy storage / inverter-based resources.
* Specify relays, current and voltage transformers, trip circuits, lockout schemes, breaker-failure protection, and communications-assisted schemes (permissive, blocking, transfer trip).
* Perform short-circuit, protective-device coordination, and arc-flash studies; keep settings aligned with the study of record as the system changes.
* Commission protection systems: functional checks, primary and secondary injection, end-to-end scheme tests, and in-service timing checks. Use industry test sets (e.g. Doble, Omicron).
* Collect and analyze fault and disturbance records (COMTRADE and equivalent); recommend setting or scheme changes after events, misoperations, or staged tests.
* Maintain the settings management database, as-left files, and firmware/config control for in-service relays.
* Integrate protection with SCADA, RTUs, and plant/facility monitoring: DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850 (including GOOSE), and IEEE C37.118 synchrophasors as applicable.
* Support NERC PRC evidence and testing where the interconnection or generation/storage fleet requires it (e.g. PRC-005, PRC-019, PRC-024, PRC-027).
* Work with field technicians, operators, and contractors during outages, switching, and troubleshooting. Stay hands-on at the panel.
* Apply IEEE C37 (including line, transformer, bus, and generator protection), NESC, NFPA 70 / 70E, IEEE 1547, and IEEE 2800 as they apply to the assets in scope.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or another engineering discipline.
* 3+ years of protection and controls experience (settings, design, or commissioning) on medium- or high-voltage systems.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years in a protection and controls role at a utility, independent power producer, EPC, relay manufacturer (e.g. SEL), or hyperscale / colocation data center operator.
* Hands-on experience with Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) relays and software (AcSELerator QuickSet, synchroWAVe Event, or equivalent). GE, ABB, Siemens, or Beckwith experience also valued.
* SELogic or equivalent relay logic; settings templates; a formal settings management process.
* Short-circuit and coordination studies in ETAP, ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, SKM, or EasyPower.
* Transmission and distribution protection (line, bus, transformer, feeder) plus at least one of: generator protection, BESS/inverter-based resource protection, or mission-critical facility / data hall medium-voltage protection.
* Commissioning with Doble F6150, Omicron CMC, or equivalent; event-record analysis after faults.
* Familiarity with DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850, IEEE C37.118, IEEE C37.111, and IEEE C37.232.
* Working knowledge of IEEE C37.102 (generator), C37.91 (transformer), C37.234 (bus), IEEE 1547 / 2800 (interconnection and inverter-based resources), and applicable NERC PRC standards.\
* Professional Engineering license, or actively working toward one.
* Ability to support technicians in the field and to remain effective during outages and event investigations.

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.
* Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support construction, energization, and operations.
* Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.
* Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted.
* Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies.
* Willing to work on-site in Memphis, TN. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
* Travel up to 25% for factory witness testing, vendor and OEM engagement, and supporting other sites.
* Valid driver's license.

new_jobs.title: Manufacturing Controls Engineer

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role focused on improving equipment reliability, automation, manufacturing efficiency, and overall plant performance. * Program, troubleshoot, modify, and optimize PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment.

* Integrate and improve automated equipment, robotics, machine vision, and motion control systems.
* Support CNC equipment, automated inspection systems, and other complex manufacturing technologies.
* Maintain and update electrical schematics, controls documentation, and equipment standards.

* Support continuous improvement, equipment reliability, and preventive maintenance initiatives.

* Lead equipment upgrades, automation projects, and new equipment installations.
* Develop project scopes, technical specifications, budgets, and implementation plans.
* Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, contractors, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Oversee equipment commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and production handoff.
* Provide technical guidance and training to maintenance technicians and production personnel.
* Support electrical safety, machine safeguarding, and compliance with applicable industrial standards.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience working with **industrial controls and automated equipment in a manufacturing environment.**
* Strong hands-on experience with **PLC programming, troubleshooting, and HMI systems.**
* Ability to troubleshoot industrial electrical systems, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, and motor controls.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and modifying electrical schematics.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing equipment, industrial automation, and electrical troubleshooting.
* Ability to independently diagnose complex equipment issues and implement practical solutions.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with production, maintenance, and engineering teams.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

As a member of the facilities engineering team, you will design, build, and activate some of the world's most technically advanced facilities and data centers. As a lead electrical engineer, you will lead a team designing, building, and maintaining power systems that directly contribute to new infrastructure projects. You will be able to operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex problems, excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will work with other MEP engineers, trade partners, and internal customers to support these goals and have the opportunity to drive real global impact, ultimately leading to making life multiplanetary.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead a team of electrical engineers and work in a team environment with other engineering disciplines to provide detailed electrical design and specifications for the installation of the following equipment and systems:

  + Switch-gear and motor control centers.
  + Exterior and interior lighting.

  + Standby and emergency generators.
  + Automatic transfer switches.
  + Power monitoring hardware and software.
  + Data/phone distribution and wiring.
  + Building and site grounding systems.

  + Load flow analysis of electrical power distribution systems.
  + Electrical equipment evaluation.
  + Building and facility equipment grounding.
  + Power monitoring hardware and software.
* Ensure that all equipment interfaces properly with other mechanical and electrical systems, including compatibility with facility power budgets.
* Coordinate all electrical installations and maintenance activities with local electrical utilities personnel.
* Ensure all electrical designs and installations conform to applicable codes and regulations.
* Provide code review and analysis utilizing NFPA 70E, NFPA 70 NEC, NFPA 497, NFPA 101, Vol 5 & 6 AFSPCMAN 91-710, and IBC.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline.
* 3+ years of professional experience working on electrical projects, power distribution systems, switchgear, UPS's, and/or generators.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

new_jobs.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

**Job Title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems Engineer**

**Location: Arnold AFB, TN**

**Job Family Code: O - Engineering**

**Function/Branch: Engineering/ID&C**

**Directorate: Mission Information Services**

**Position Type: Regular, Full-Time**

**Pay Type: Exempt**

**Grade: L09(TA0913) - L10(TA1015)**

**Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate: L09: $112,000 - $149,500; L10: $131,000 - $174,500/ per year**

  

**Overview**

Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for an HWIL Systems Engineer supporting the Test Operations and Sustainment (TOS) II contract at Arnold Engineering Development Complex (AEDC), Arnold Air Force Base, TN.

  

In this role, you will be the primary operational lead for the Range Systems Support Laboratory (RSSL), an operational facility that provides AEDC with the ability to simulate complex testing environments to develop, test, and validate software and controls logic. You will oversee lab modernization, configuration management, and readiness to ensure mission-critical ground test support for key national aerospace programs. You will also maintain readiness for HWIL systems that have been deployed to test facilities.

  

If you are seeing this posting on an external job board, BNH highly recommends you apply directly on the Careers Center page of our business website (https://careers-bnh.icims.com/jobs). Job board applications are not always compatible with company applicant tracking systems.

  

***Open to internal and external candidates.***

  

**Job Summary**

The HWIL Systems Engineer is responsible for ensuring operational readiness of the RSSL, a critical simulation and testing environment. This includes managing lab configurations, supporting pre-test mission evaluations, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring the facility is prepared for a wide range of validation activities. The successful candidate will interface daily with System Administrators, Controls and Data SMEs, Control Systems Engineers, Facility Modeling Engineers, and external vendors like MathWorks to support development and troubleshooting.

This role is central to reducing risk and cost for AEDC by enabling robust "off-line" analysis and investigation of operational issues without requiring costly "air-on" facility time. Key strategic initiatives for this role include leading efforts in modernization, automated regression testing, reflective memory replacement, and footprint consolidation.

  

**Job Duties:**

* Maintain a stable, structured environment for plant simulation, development, and checkout activities for facilities such as the Engine Test Facility (ETF), Propulsion Wind Tunnel (PWT), and Aerodynamic and Propulsion Test Unit (APTU).
* Work with HWIL users to troubleshoot the simulation environment.
* Lead Lab Configuration Management, ensuring all hardware, software, and simulation models are under strict revision control.
* Direct and prepare lab configurations for testing and validation, including pre-test mission evaluations to ensure readiness.
* Serve as the primary interface with System Administrators, Modeling and Controls SMEs, Data SMEs, Control Systems Engineers, Facility Modeling Engineers, and software vendors (e.g., MathWorks) to support simulation, development, and issue resolution.
* Oversee and drive key lab modernization initiatives, including reflective memory replacement, automated regression testing, authoring the next generation of High-Speed Digital Interface, and footprint consolidation, using software vendors as necessary.
* Work with System Administrators to provide a consistent user experience by managing centralized services, including account management, security control, file servers, and simulation status monitoring.
* Support the training of facility operators and systems engineers on new or revised control systems, contributing to the 'Safe Reliable Effective Operation' (SREO) initiative.
* Maintain readiness for HWIL systems that have been deployed to test facilities
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies to identify and evaluate opportunities for improving the efficiency, performance, and reliability of deployed systems.
* It is a condition of employment to wear company-issued Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.
  

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Computer Engineering from an accredited institution and a minimum of eight (8) years of engineering experience in an aerospace, industrial test, or R&D environment, which includes:
  + Professional experience with the development, integration, or sustainment of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) systems, real-time simulation environments, or industrial control systems (ICS).
  + Experience with configuration management and troubleshooting of hardware and software within a laboratory or test facility.
* OR, in lieu of a bachelor’s degree, a high school diploma or equivalent and a minimum of twelve (12) years of professional technical experience in the same fields, which includes:
  + Professional experience with the development, integration, or sustainment of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) systems, real-time simulation environments, or industrial control systems (ICS).
  + Experience with configuration management and troubleshooting of hardware and software within a laboratory or test facility.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain an active security clearance and maintain authorized user access to the AEDC local area network.
* U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal government contract compliance requirements and the necessity to access secure federal databases and networks on Arnold Air Force Base.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and/or simulation environments.
* Background in a DoD, aerospace, or industrial test/R

Who We Are:  
Venus Aerospace is revolutionizing rocket engine propulsion. With the first generational leap in rocket engine technology since Apollo, our proprietary Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine and Venus Detonation Ramjets deliver historic efficiency and performance across aerospace applications. We are building the next generation of propulsion platforms that enable breakthrough capabilities in space, defense, and commercial high-speed flight. Our team thrives on solving the toughest engineering challenges and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in aerospace. At Venus, we’re looking for bold engineers and innovators who want to make history and redefine the future of propulsion.

The Role: Embedded Software Engineer  
We are seeking a talented Embedded Software Engineer to help develop the flight software that powers our next-generation avionics and flight computer systems. You’ll join a small, multidisciplinary Software team that currently spans embedded systems, ground software, hardware test and data acquisition, HIL/V&V, and internal enterprise software. As an early member of our growing Embedded Software team, you’ll have significant ownership in shaping the architecture, processes, and technical direction of this area. As the company grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on technical and people leadership and help build out the Embedded Software organization.

* Develop Flight Software

Build for Reliability:

Real-time Systems:

### **What Will Set You Apart**

**About Neuralink:**

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

**Team Description:**

Neuralink's Information Technology team owns the corporate environment that every engineer, scientist, and clinician depends on to do their work. Within IT, the Compute function is responsible for the physical and server infrastructure that powers neural recording training, data processing, and engineering workloads: the data center floor itself, the GPU and HPC clusters that run on it, and the storage, provisioning, and monitoring that keep those systems healthy. We build this infrastructure from the ground up, manage it as code, and treat uptime for research workloads as production.

**Job Description and Responsibilities:**

Neuralink is looking for a hands-on Systems Engineer with deep expertise in data center design, build, and operations. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our compute and storage infrastructure, from site buildout and hardware procurement through deployment, automation, and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate brings equal comfort on the data center floor and at the keyboard, thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, and has a passion for building reliable, scalable systems from the ground up. The job responsibilities will include:

* Design, build, and operate data center environments including power infrastructure (PDUs, UPS, generators), cooling systems (CRAC/CRAH, liquid cooling), and scalable racking; drive capacity planning for power, cooling, and floor space

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience building and supporting HPC or high-density compute environments: GPU clusters, high-performance storage
* Hands-on experience with data center power, cooling, and racking design and operations
* Strong Linux server administration experience; working knowledge of Windows Server
* Experience automating bare-metal provisioning (PXE/HTTP boot) and configuration management with Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet
* Familiarity with DCIM tools and infrastructure monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with cluster resource managers (Slurm, LSF, PBS)
* Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/Proxmox) and storage ecosystems (NAS/SAN, NFS/iSCSI)

new_jobs.title: Lead Application Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Role Overview:

At McAfee, you'll architect and lead platform solutions in a fast-paced environment where innovation shapes enterprise infrastructure. As a Lead Application Platform Engineer, you'll set technical direction, establish patterns and standards for platform teams, and drive architectural decisions that impact multiple product engineering groups. This technical  
leadership role elevates developer productivity and operational excellence across the organization.

The Lead Application Platform Engineer operates as a technical leader — not a manager — bringing depth, influence, and mentorship. This engineer sets the patterns and standards the platform team builds on, serves as the escalation point for production issues, and is the technical voice engineering leaders consult before major commitments. The role combines deep expertise in application architecture, platform engineering, and distributed systems with the ability to mentor and influence other engineers.

  
Position Details:

**About The Role**

  

* Embed with two to three assigned product engineering groups, participating as a functional team member while maintaining a broader platform perspective.
* Own and evolve reference architectures—a curated set of blessed patterns (synchronous services, asynchronous workers, data pipelines) with Infrastructure-as-Code starters, monitoring checklists, runbook templates, and cost models.
* Act as the escalation point for production and architecture problems across multiple engineering groups; lead technical response to major incidents alongside SRE.
* Set the technical standard for the platform team: define the bar for review approach, testing depth, instrumentation baseline, and what 'operationally ready' means in practice.
* Mentor two to four Application Platform Engineers, including onboarding new hires into unfamiliar product domains and codebases; grow the technical capabilities of the team.
* Represent platform constraints and capabilities in architecture discussions with engineering leadership; carry group constraints back into Release Engineering and SRE roadmaps.
* Drive structural fixes after major incidents; lead the analysis of root causes and oversee implementation of preventive measures.
* Evaluate and introduce tooling (AI-assisted development, test generation, performance and security tools); prove value before team standardization.
* Design multi-service architectures and reason about failure modes, blast radius, data consistency, and cost before code is written.
* Contribute meaningfully in at least two of Go, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, or .NET; comfortable in a third at short notice.
* Lead capacity and scalability analysis; interpret profiling and tracing data to locate bottlenecks across service boundaries.
* Build internal tooling and automation frameworks that the rest of the platform team depends on, including AI-assisted migration and review workflows.
* Drive security remediation strategy across the software supply chain; manage and prioritize remediation across multiple teams.

**About You**

  

* 9+ years in software, platform, or reliability engineering with deep hands-on coding experience that is still current.
* Demonstrated ownership of architecture patterns adopted by teams outside your own.
* Experience operating high-traffic distributed systems in production; leadership inincident response and post-incident structural work.
* Track record of raising the technical bar of a team through mentoring and standard-  
  setting.
* Expert-level proficiency in Go (Golang), Python, and Node.js/TypeScript; strong
* competency in Dart/Flutter; able to read and architect in Java, Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C, C++, C, Rust, and C#/.NET.
* Deep expertise in AWS (EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC) and production-grade Kubernetes across multiple deployments.
* Working knowledge of GCP/GKE and multi-cloud architecture patterns.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and Infrastructure-as- Code at scale.
* Mastery of CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions and Harness; expertise in build optimization, artifact management, and security scanning.
* Advanced knowledge of observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing (Tempo), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and alerting (CloudWatch, Datadog, Instana).
* Deep expertise in performance testing, capacity planning, and scalability analysis using K6, Locust, or JMeter.
* Advanced knowledge of databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, SQL Server) and query optimization.
* Expertise with event-driven architectures and message streaming (Confluent Kafka, Redis).
* Security supply chain mastery: SonarQube, BlackDuck/Coverity, Dependabot, JFrog; ability to architect and drive remediation strategies.
* Expert use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and ability to evaluate new AI tooling for team adoption.
* Desired Skills include:
  + Mobile DevOps mastery (Fastlane with Flutter/Dart, Swift, Kotlin builds; mobile testing automation).
  + Advanced experience with Kong API gateway, Okta RBAC, and Backstage-based developer platforms.
  + Deep familiarity with internal service frameworks (Gofr, NodeFr/Zode).
  + LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic AI orchestration experience.
  + Published technical writing or speaking about platform engineering, architecture, or DevOps at conferences.
  + Cloud Solutions Architect certifications (AWS, GCP).
  + Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).

Company Overview:

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Austin, Texas, United States | Full-time

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

new_jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)
new_jobs.description:
**Title:** Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)

**Hours:** Full-time

**Location:** Midvale, UT (On-site with occasional remote flexibility) #LI-Onsite

**You report to:** Software Engineering Manager

**Compensation:** A base salary range of $120,000-$135,000 gross per year, depending on candidate experience.

**Our Benefits:**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with BioLite covering 90–100% of monthly premiums, depending on plan selection.
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Paid Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, sick time, and family leave to support work-life balance.
* Equity & Bonus Opportunities: Community bonus plan and stock option eligibility for all full-time employees.
* Adventure Stipend (after two years): PTO to go on an adventure that aligns with BioLite's mission of bringing energy everywhere, whether that's outdoor recreation, climate action, or social impact.
* Employee Product Discount: Employees enjoy generous discounts on BioLite and Goal Zero products.

  

**This Role:**

BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Midvale-based team. In this role, you will develop the firmware that connects our power products to the cloud (AWS IoT) and to our Flutter and React Native mobile apps. You will work on the wireless connectivity modules in our home backup and portable power products. These modules work alongside battery management, inverter, and power conversion subsystems. You will focus on provisioning, OTA updates, device-to-cloud messaging, fleet telemetry, and the protocols among modules in the rest of the system. Our current products use the ESP32, and you will help choose and bring up the wireless platform for our next generation of products. Options we are looking at include embedded Rust (Embassy), embedded Linux, and smart home standards such as Matter and Thread.

A large part of this job is making existing firmware better. You will refactor, add tests, and pay down technical debt so the team ships faster with fewer field issues. You will work with firmware, electrical, cloud, and mobile engineers. You will debug at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and your code will run on devices in homes and in the field.

**You Will:**

* **Develop connectivity-module firmware:** Develop and maintain firmware for our Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity modules, including provisioning, configuration, OTA updates, and device-to-cloud messaging.
* **Improve the codebase you inherit:** Refactor existing firmware, add unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests, and set coding standards that make changes safe and code reviews fast.
* **Build communication protocols:** Develop the protocol libraries that connect our subsystems (battery management, inverter, IoT module) to each other and to the mobile app.
* **Lead the firmware build and release pipeline:** Maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions for firmware builds, tests, and releases for your projects. Make OTA releases reliable and traceable.
* **Work across the device-to-cloud path:** Work with cloud and mobile engineers on device APIs (AWS IoT), fleet telemetry, and app integration. Debug issues end-to-end, from the radio to the app.
* **Use modern tools:** Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up prototyping, debugging, testing, and documentation.
* **Review and document:** Take part in code and design reviews. Document designs for other developers, QA, manufacturing partners, and support.

  

**You Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; OR 5+ years of directly relevant experience.
* 3+ years writing production firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers or SoCs (e.g., Espressif ESP32, Nordic nRF, ST STM32, or other Arm Cortex-M).
* Experience with a real-time operating system (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and a wireless vendor SDK (e.g., ESP-IDF, nRF Connect SDK).
* Working knowledge of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and an IoT messaging protocol such as MQTT.
* Working knowledge of bootloaders, OTA updates, and device provisioning.
* Working knowledge of serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Experience testing embedded code (unit tests, simulation, or hardware-in-the-loop).
* Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for build, test, and tooling scripts.
* Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD.
* Experience with AI coding assistants in your daily work.

  

**Nice to Have:**

You do not need the following skills to apply, but please let us know if you have experience in any of these areas.

* Experience with AWS IoT Core or another cloud IoT platform, including REST APIs.
* Experience with mobile app development (native, Flutter, or React Native).
* Experience with smart home protocols such as Matter, Thread, Zigbee, or Z-Wave.
* Experience with or interest in embedded Rust (e.g., Embassy) or embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot).
* Experience with fleet monitoring, device telemetry, or crash reporting.
* Experience with consumer electronics, batteries, or power conversion.

  

**To Apply:**

* Please include a cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for this position. Feel free to link or describe a relevant personal project, hobby build, or open-source contribution that highlights your firmware or software skills.
* **You must be authorized to work for an employer in the U.S.** BioLite cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position.

  

**About BioLite:**

BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces to power life, anywhere. Together, we provide clean energy solutions that serve two distinct yet connected markets: families living in energy poverty and outdoor adventurers seeking fuel-independent power and light. From solar panels and portable power stations to cookstoves and lighting systems, our technologies help people cook, charge, and stay connect

**Embedded Systems Engineer**

**Job Location: Onsite Logan, UT**

**JOB SUMMARY**

Develop the firmware and low-level software that bring Juniper Systems’ rugged computers, GNSS receivers, and data collectors to life. This engineer works at the boundary between hardware and software — firmware, drivers, power management, and device bring-up — and partners closely with electrical engineering to make sure new hardware works reliably with the operating system and applications above it.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Develops and maintains embedded firmware, including power management, device configuration, and update mechanisms.
* Brings up new hardware and verifies that hardware and software work together correctly.
* Develops or adapts drivers and low-level software that connect custom hardware to Windows, Android, Linux, or Embedded OS.
* Integrates and configures third-party modules and firmware such as wireless, touch, and positioning components.
* Diagnoses and resolves problems that span hardware and software in development, manufacturing, and the field.
* Works with electrical engineering, partners, and suppliers on requirements, design reviews, and deliverables.
* Documents designs.
* Mentors others in areas of expertise.

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, and REQUIREMENTS**

Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field and 4–8 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Required:**

* Experience developing and debugging low-level software including device drivers, firmware, boot loaders, UEFI/BIOS, and peripheral interfaces.
* Experience specifying low-level components, functionality, acceptance tests.
* Ability to read schematics and datasheets and to work hands-on with hardware.
* Proficiency with standard electronics lab and debugging equipment.
* Strong, methodical troubleshooting skills across hardware and software.
* Disciplined use of version control and change management.
* Ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies, methods, and tools to solve problems.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with power management, battery systems, or low-power design.
* Experience with BIOS/UEFI, embedded controllers, or device drivers.
* Experience integrating wireless, cellular, GNSS, and sensor modules.
* Experience with rugged or battery-powered computing products.
* Expert use of AI-assisted engineering tools, with independent verification of results.

**RESPONSIBILITY, ACCOUNTABILITY, and SUPERVISORY REPONSIBILITIES**

May act as a technical lead on development projects. Responsible for aspects of software design of new products, with sustaining and support functions of existing products as needed. Responsible for evaluating and mitigating technical design risks. May supervise other engineers or interns.

Office and lab environment. Requires extended computer work and hands-on use of electronic test equipment and prototype hardware.

Normally 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday on a 9/80 schedule; may occasionally require additional hours. Occasional travel to partner, manufacturing, or field-test sites.

new_jobs.title: Senior Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Senior GSE Software Engineer  
**Requisition ID:** 1884  
**Position Location:** Sterling, VA  
**Position Reports To:** Director, Software Engineering  
**Supervises Others:** No

At Trident Systems, we believe that strong engineering principles are fundamental to driving innovation and solving complex problems. We promote a culture characterized by rigorous engineering practices and a commitment to continuous improvement. This is achieved by leveraging our organization's collective expertise through collaborative development processes, which include thorough design and peer reviews. We can deliver innovative, high-performance solutions that meet our customers' evolving requirements by integrating our specialized knowledge in aerospace electronic systems with appropriately scaled development methodologies.

We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and evolution of the software platforms that control our automated electronic test and support systems. This role owns the technical direction and architecture of reusable software frameworks that serve both engineering development and production test environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern Python software engineering, asynchronous systems programming, hardware communications, and software architecture. You will define, build, and continuously improve the core GSE software platform that enables reliable, maintainable, and scalable automated test and support systems across multiple programs and product lines.

You will collaborate closely with the Lead Test Systems Engineer, Integration & Test engineers, the Engineering Systems Integration Engineer, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the GSE software platform aligns with organizational needs and supports long-term engineering infrastructure.

Success in this role is measured by:

* Robustness, stability, and maintainability of the core platform
* Reliability and uptime of production test operations
* Measurable productivity gains for engineering and test teams
* Effective reuse of frameworks across projects and programs
* The ability to support increasingly sophisticated automated GSE and test systems

What Makes This Role Distinct?

This is not a QA automation or web application role. The Senior GSE Software Engineer:

* Defines and owns the reusable software platform that powers automated electronic test systems and Ground Support Equipment.
* Sets the technical direction and architecture for long-lived engineering infrastructure supporting multiple products and programs.
* Operates at the intersection of software engineering, hardware control, and systems integration to enable sophisticated, mission-critical automated test and support operations.

In this role, you will be the technical leader ensuring that our GSE software platform is robust, extensible, and capable of supporting increasingly complex automated systems—directly influencing engineering efficiency, product quality, and production reliability.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

Technical Leadership & Architecture

* Define the overarching GSE software platform architecture, including standards, design principles, and best practices.
* Design scalable asynchronous software architectures for concurrent control of instruments and support equipment.
* Lead the development of reusable Python frameworks that underpin automated GSE and test systems.
* Establish clear abstractions, interfaces, and patterns for instruments, communication buses, and test procedures.
* Evaluate and select tools, libraries, and technologies for the GSE software stack, providing well-reasoned recommendations and tradeoff analyses.

Framework & Platform Development

* Develop reusable instruments and communication abstractions that can be applied consistently across diverse projects and test systems.
* Architect and implement execution frameworks for sequencing, scheduling, concurrency, error handling, logging, and health monitoring.
* Design and build measurement acquisition, data processing, and results management software integrated with enterprise engineering tools and data systems.
* Implement robust configuration, deployment, and monitoring mechanisms for GSE software in both laboratory and production environments.

System Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with the Lead Test Systems Engineer to co-develop the framework architecture that underpins all automated test systems.
* Work with Integration & Test engineers to translate I&T requirements into reliable, maintainable automated test procedures on the GSE platform.
* Collaborate with the Engineering Systems Integration Engineer to integrate GSE software with enterprise systems (e.g., engineering databases, PLM, configuration management, data repositories).
* Provide expert support to production test operations, including diagnosing complex system issues, improving performance, and enhancing reliability.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

* Champion professional software engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and configuration management.
* Mentor and coach software and test engineers in asynchronous programming, software architecture, and best practices for automated test and GSE systems.
* Drive continuous improvement in coding standards, design guidelines, and development workflows for the GSE software ecosystem.
* Lead root-cause analysis efforts for complex GSE software issues and implement durable corrective actions that improve system behavior over time.

The Software Engineer III is a key technical contributor within Oceaneering Technologies (OTECH), responsible for driving software development efforts that support one‑of‑a‑kind underwater systems built for U.S. Navy and other DoW customers. Engineers at this level apply deep understanding of the software lifecycle to design system architectures, lead or significantly contribute to project software activities, and ensure delivered solutions satisfy electrical, mechanical, and operational (CONOPS) needs while collaborating closely with engineering leads, project managers, and external customers.

Beyond feature leadership, this role executes hands‑on systems software work across Linux‑based distributed and embedded environments—implementing system services and application components; building hardware/software interfaces and device drivers; enabling data‑processing functions; and delivering robust communications capabilities. Typical development spans native Linux and containerized deployments (e.g., Docker/Podman) with orchestration via Kubernetes, and leverages DDS‑based publish/subscribe messaging for real‑time, mission‑critical data exchange—consistent with OTECH integration‑lab practices and container/DDS orchestration patterns.

Engineers will participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements implementation, software design, coding, unit and integration testing, debugging, peer reviews, configuration management, and technical documentation. The role benefits from a systems‑programming foundation (memory/resource management, multithreading/concurrency, IPC, networking, and efficient data structures) and facility with modern toolchains and build systems (GCC/Clang, Cargo, CMake), debugging and analysis tools (GDB, sanitizers), and structured data formats (JSON, XML). Work products are supported by CI/CD pipelines and automated testing to ensure reliability and repeatability; engineers frequently contribute to test harnesses and lab workflows that validate containerized services and DDS participants under failure‑recovery and health‑check scenarios.

Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, the ability to see the big picture, and a capacity to devise innovative solutions when conventional approaches fall short. Engineers are expected to mentor junior developers, support proposal and design trade studies, and participate in software testing across factory floor, offsite, and offshore environments—developing solutions that integrate seamlessly with sensors, SBC‑based control systems, and mission operations while meeting documentation and CDRL acceptance criteria consistent with OTECH standards.

new_jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

Baxter Manufacturing, a division of ITW Food Equipment Group, is seeking a Software Engineer to support software and connected-product development for commercial food equipment.

This position serves as the technical lead between Baxter and third-party software development partners. Responsibilities include defining requirements, coordinating development, testing and validating completed software, troubleshooting field issues, and supporting releases throughout the product lifecycle.

The role supports embedded controls, touchscreen interfaces, connected applications, Microsoft Azure cloud services, APIs, databases, and wireless connectivity. Most major software development is performed by external partners; however, the engineer must have sufficient software experience to understand and troubleshoot code, evaluate proposed solutions, and perform smaller software or firmware updates when appropriate.

* Lead assigned software projects from requirements through development, validation, release, and field support.
* Translate product, customer, service, and engineering needs into clear software requirements, scopes of work, and acceptance criteria.

* Review proposed solutions and verify completed software meets functional, reliability, usability, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Support embedded control software, touchscreen applications, microcontrollers, and ESP32-based connectivity solutions.
* Support Microsoft Azure systems used for device provisioning, over-the-air updates, telemetry, diagnostics, and connected-equipment management.
* Troubleshoot communication between equipment, embedded controllers, networks, applications, APIs, and cloud services.
* Use tools such as Postman to test APIs and troubleshoot software integrations.

* Troubleshoot software and connectivity issues found during engineering testing, manufacturing, or on equipment installed in the field.
* Use telemetry, logs, diagnostic information, and laboratory testing to identify root cause and corrective actions.
* Support Wi-Fi connectivity and customer cybersecurity requirements, including security questionnaires, trust-center reviews, and technical discussions with customer IT organizations.
* Communicate software architecture, network requirements, data flows, cloud connectivity, and update processes to technical and non-technical audiences.
100% on site role interacting with production and other departments

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 2+ years of professional experience in software development, embedded systems, connected products, or software systems engineering.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ever wondered how Amazon keeps hundreds of fulfillment centers running at peak performance across the globe? That's where our team comes in.  
  
We build the real-time data platform that gives Amazon's fulfillment network end-to-end visibility — from conveyor belts and robotic systems to software applications and workforce operations. Think of it as the central nervous system for Amazon's physical logistics: we ingest millions of data points per second from equipment and systems across 100+ facilities worldwide, store years of historical data without sacrificing query speed, and serve it all up through dashboards, APIs, and SDKs that help teams detect problems before they happen, optimize processes in real time, and make smarter decisions about how to move packages faster.  
  
What makes this role different:  
  
This isn't a typical web services role. You'll work at the intersection of physical operations and cloud-scale software — solving problems where hardware unpredictability meets distributed systems challenges. The data you help collect and serve directly impacts whether a package gets delivered on time, whether equipment gets serviced before it breaks, and whether an entire facility runs smoothly on its busiest day of the year.  
  
You'll own problems end-to-end, from system design through production operations, and your work will be visible in real-world outcomes across Amazon's global logistics network.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll design and build distributed systems that operate at massive scale — processing high-velocity time-series data streams, building storage layers that balance performance with cost, and creating APIs that make complex data accessible to thousands of users. Right now, we're in the middle of a major storage architecture migration, rethinking how we handle hot data to improve reliability and reduce latency. You'll also have the opportunity to work on data ingestion pipelines that collect signals from industrial hardware, robotics, and software systems — and turn that raw telemetry into actionable insights.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

**Verathon®** is looking for an Electrical Engineer III to become the newest member of our Urology R&D team located in Bothell, WA. MS degree in technical field with at least 5 years of related experience.

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Design Studies
new_jobs.description:
Madison, Wisconsin, United States | Full-time

Apply by: No close date

  

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

Our team helps customers with project conceptual development, support during design, equipment selection and assistance with operating issues after COD. We assist with apparatus ratings and specifications development for transformers, circuit breakers, switches, cables, series capacitors, dynamic var devices, etc.

**Minimum** **Requirements:** MSEE (PhD is desirable)15+ year performing most of the studies listed above.Expert user of PSCAD. (knowledge of ATP and EMTP-RV a plus); expert user of positive sequence/phasor domain tools; a professional engineers license is preferred but not required. The successful applicant may be subject to client-mandated drug and background checking. Occasional travel/driving is required; therefore, the successful applicant will be subject to ECI's auto insurance carrier requirements. Applicants must not require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status) now or in the future.

**Salary commensurate with experience and education. Benefits include:**

* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Disability insurance
* 401(k), profit sharing and employee stock ownership plan
* Paid vacation, personal days and holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Continued professional education reimbursement
